note: English (global) dish dictionary. Descriptions written from English Wikipedia intros, keeping what the dish is, its main ingredients, how it is made or served and how it tastes (history, origin, regions and nutrition left out); each intro was first checked to be about that dish. Built 2026-10-11 in the app on the linked Grok subscription (DictBuild.swift). Keys are the Wikipedia titles; aliases map menu and Korean names to them.

desc.Fried chicken: Fried chicken consists of chicken pieces coated in seasoned flour or batter, then pan-fried, deep-fried, pressure-fried or air-fried until the exterior is crisp and golden while the meat stays juicy. It is typically served hot as a main dish or snack, often with sides, and has a savory, crunchy taste.
desc.Carrot cake: Carrot cake is a moist spiced cake made by mixing grated carrots into the batter along with neutral oil, then baked and usually topped with rich cream cheese frosting. It is served in slices at room temperature or chilled, offering a sweet, spiced flavor with subtle carrot taste and creamy topping.
desc.Tempura: Tempura consists of seafood and vegetables coated in a thin, light batter then deep-fried until crisp and pale golden. It is served hot, often with a dipping sauce, delivering a delicate crunch and clean taste of the fresh ingredients inside.
desc.Doughnut: A doughnut is a sweet fried or baked ring-shaped or filled pastry made from leavened dough, often topped with sugar, chocolate, or glaze. It is served as a snack or breakfast item with a soft, airy texture and sweet flavor that varies by type and topping.
desc.Doppio: Doppio is a double shot of espresso made by extracting twice the amount of ground coffee to yield about 60 ml of concentrated, bold coffee. It is served hot in a small cup, with a rich, intense taste and crema on top.
desc.Tonkatsu: Tonkatsu is a Japanese pork cutlet made from slices of pork loin or fillet coated in panko breadcrumbs and deep-fried until golden and crispy. It is typically served sliced with rice or in a sandwich, offering a juicy interior and crunchy exterior with savory pork flavor.
desc.Dongpo pork: Dongpo pork is a dish of thick squares of pork belly pan-fried then red-cooked until tender and juicy without excess greasiness. It is served hot with skin, fat, and lean meat, featuring a fragrant, savory taste often enhanced by wine in the braising liquid.
desc.Doenjang-jjigae: Doenjang-jjigae is a Korean soybean paste stew made by simmering doenjang with vegetables, seafood or meat in a broth. It is served bubbling hot in a pot, with a savory, earthy, and slightly salty taste that varies by added ingredients.
desc.Dubu-kimchi: Dubu-kimchi consists of soft, warm blanched tofu served alongside stir-fried, well-fermented napa cabbage kimchi with pork. It is typically presented as a shared dish or drinking snack, combining mild tofu with tangy, spicy kimchi flavors.
desc.Drip coffee: Drip coffee is brewed by pouring hot water over ground coffee beans, allowing it to seep through and drip into a vessel while a filter retains the grounds. It is served hot, often black or with additions, resulting in a clean, aromatic cup with balanced flavor depending on the beans and method.
desc.BLT: A BLT is a classic sandwich made with crispy bacon, fresh lettuce, and sliced tomato, often layered between toasted bread with mayonnaise. It is typically served cold or at room temperature, delivering a satisfying combination of smoky, crunchy, juicy, and creamy textures and flavors.
desc.Galbi: LA Galbi consists of marinated beef short ribs that are grilled at the table in Korean barbecue restaurants. The ribs are usually cut across the bone in a thin, long style, marinated in a sweet-savory blend of soy sauce, garlic, and sugar, then cooked until tender and caramelized for a juicy, smoky taste.
desc.Karaage: Karaage is Japanese fried chicken where small pieces of marinated chicken are coated in starch and deep-fried until golden and crispy. It is commonly served hot with a side of rice and shredded cabbage, offering a juicy interior and crunchy exterior with savory, ginger-soy flavors.
desc.Katsudon: Katsudon is a Japanese rice bowl topped with a crispy fried pork cutlet simmered in a sweet-savory sauce with lightly cooked egg and vegetables. It is served hot as a comforting, hearty meal where the crunchy cutlet contrasts with the soft rice and fluffy egg.
desc.Gamja-jeon: Gamja-jeon is a Korean potato pancake made by pan-frying grated potato in oil until golden brown and crispy on both sides. It is served hot as a savory dish with a soft interior and crunchy exterior, often accompanied by a dipping sauce.
desc.French fries: French fries are deep-fried potato strips that are golden, crispy on the outside, and fluffy inside. They are served hot, typically salted, as a side dish or snack and commonly paired with ketchup or other condiments for a savory, satisfying taste.
desc.Gyeran-mari: Gyeran-mari is a Korean rolled omelette made by cooking beaten eggs mixed with finely diced vegetables, mushrooms, or ham, then rolling it into a log shape. It is sliced into rounds and served as a savory side dish with a fluffy, mildly seasoned taste.
desc.Gyeran-ppang: Gyeran-ppang is a South Korean street-food bread that is fluffy and oblong, filled with a whole egg baked into sweet-savory pancake-like dough. It is served warm, combining soft bread with the rich, custardy egg for a balanced sweet and savory flavor.
desc.Fried sweet potato: Fried sweet potato consists of sweet potato slices or strips that are battered and deep-fried until crispy outside and tender inside. It is served hot as a side or snack, offering a sweet, earthy taste with a satisfying crunchy texture.
desc.Gỏi cuốn: Gỏi cuốn, also known as summer rolls or fresh spring rolls, are a Vietnamese dish of pork, prawns, rice vermicelli, and vegetables wrapped in soft rice paper. They are served fresh and uncooked at room temperature, often with a dipping sauce, offering a light, refreshing taste with a mix of textures from the crisp vegetables and tender proteins.
desc.Pepper steak: Pepper steak is a Chinese stir-fried dish of sliced beef with bell peppers, onions, and seasonings like soy sauce and ginger, often thickened into a sauce. It is typically served hot over rice, with a savory, slightly spicy flavor from the tender beef and crisp vegetables.
desc.Golbaengi-muchim: Golbaengi-muchim is a Korean spicy salad made by mixing moon snails with vegetables in a red chili-based sauce. It is served cold or at room temperature, often with noodles as a chewy, spicy, and refreshing snack.
desc.Gomguk: Gomguk is a Korean beef bone soup made by slow-simmering various beef parts like ribs or oxtail. The milky broth has a rich and hearty taste and is served hot, often with rice.
desc.Gopchang: Gopchang refers to grilled or prepared cattle or pig intestines in Korean cuisine, known for their chewy texture with rich elastic fibers. It is often served as a barbecue, in stews, or soups, with a savory and slightly gamey flavor.
desc.Gujeolpan: Gujeolpan is an elaborate Korean platter featuring nine assorted foods like namul vegetables, meats, mushrooms, and seafood arranged around small wheat pancakes in a divided octagonal plate. It is served for diners to assemble their own bites, offering a variety of fresh, seasoned, and savory tastes.
desc.Gukbap: Gukbap is a Korean dish of rice served directly in a hot soup, commonly in a stone pot, where the rice is mixed into the broth. It has a comforting, hearty taste from the combined flavors of the soup and rice.
desc.Gukhwa-ppang: Gukhwa-ppang is a Korean flower-shaped pastry stuffed with sweetened red bean paste. It is grilled until warm and crispy on the outside with a sweet, soft filling inside.
desc.Gyūdon: Gyūdon is a Japanese beef bowl of rice topped with thinly sliced beef and onions simmered in a sweet-savory sauce made from dashi, soy sauce, and mirin. It is served hot, often with toppings like egg or pickled ginger, offering tender meat with a mildly sweet and umami-rich flavor.
desc.Green curry: Green curry is a Thai curry known for its vibrant green color from fresh herbs. It features coconut milk, green chilies, and ingredients like chicken or vegetables, simmered into a creamy, aromatic sauce that is both spicy and slightly sweet.
desc.Gyros: Gyros is a Greek dish of meat, typically pork or chicken, cooked on a vertical rotisserie and sliced thin. It is served wrapped in pita bread with tomato, onion, and tzatziki sauce, providing a savory, juicy taste with creamy and fresh accompaniments.
desc.Gimbap: Gimbap is a Korean dish of cooked rice, vegetables, and optional meat or seafood rolled in dried seaweed sheets and sliced into bite-sized pieces. It is served at room temperature, with a balanced savory and mildly seasoned flavor from the rolled ingredients.
desc.Kimchi-jjigae: Kimchi jjigae is a Korean stew made with kimchi and other ingredients such as pork, scallions, onions, and diced tofu. It is simmered together into a hearty, spicy, and savory dish that is commonly served bubbling hot in a pot at the table.
desc.Carbonara: Carbonara is an Italian pasta dish made with cured pork like guanciale or pancetta, hard cheese such as pecorino romano, eggs, salt, and black pepper. The ingredients are combined with hot pasta to create a creamy sauce that coats the noodles, resulting in a rich, savory, and peppery flavor.
desc.Kkanpunggi: Kkanpunggi is a Korean Chinese spicy fried chicken dish where the chicken is deep-fried until crispy and then coated in a sweet and spicy sauce, typically served with vegetables. It offers a crunchy texture with bold, tangy, and fiery flavors.
desc.Nachos: Nachos are a Tex-Mex dish consisting of tortilla chips topped with melted cheese or cheese sauce and various toppings such as meats, vegetables, salsa, guacamole, or sour cream. They are served as an appetizer or main course with a crunchy, cheesy, and savory taste.
desc.Neapolitan pizza: Neapolitan pizza is an Italian round pizza with a soft, thin dough that has high, puffed edges, traditionally topped with San Marzano tomatoes and mozzarella di bufala or fior di latte. It is baked quickly in a wood-fired oven, resulting in a tender, slightly chewy crust with fresh, tangy, and milky flavors.
desc.Negroni: A Negroni is an Italian cocktail made with equal parts gin, sweet red vermouth, and Campari, typically served over ice and garnished with an orange slice or peel. It has a balanced, bittersweet, herbal, and citrusy taste that is served as an apéritif.
desc.Gnocchi: Gnocchi are Italian dumplings made from a dough of potato, wheat flour, egg, and salt, which are rolled into small pieces and boiled. They are then served with various sauces, offering a soft, pillowy texture with a mild, comforting flavor that absorbs the accompanying sauce.
desc.Dacquoise: A dacquoise is a French dessert cake consisting of layers of almond and hazelnut meringue filled with whipped cream or buttercream, usually served chilled and accompanied by fruit. It has a crisp, nutty meringue texture contrasted with creamy, sweet fillings.
desc.Anpan: Anpan is a Japanese sweet roll most commonly filled with red bean paste, though it can also contain fillings like chocolate or custard. It is soft and slightly sweet with a tender bread exterior and a smooth, earthy-sweet filling.
desc.Dak-galbi: Dakgalbi is a South Korean spicy stir-fried chicken dish where marinated diced chicken is cooked in a gochujang-based sauce with vegetables, sweet potatoes, rice cakes, and perilla leaves. It is often prepared on a hot plate at the table, resulting in a tender, fiery, and savory meal that can be wrapped in lettuce.
desc.Chicken feet: Chicken feet are cooked so that the skin and tendons become the main edible parts, resulting in a distinct gelatinous texture. They are prepared by braising, stewing, or frying and have a chewy, bouncy mouthfeel with flavors from the cooking sauce or broth.
desc.Dak-bokkeum-tang: Dak-bokkeum-tang is a Korean braised spicy chicken dish made by boiling or stir-frying chicken chunks with vegetables and spices including gochujang, chili peppers, garlic, and ginger. It simmers into a thick, hearty stew with tender chicken and a bold, spicy, and savory taste.
desc.Matcha: Matcha is a finely ground powder of shade-grown green tea that is suspended in hot water and whisked until frothy. It has a vibrant green color and a strong umami flavor with subtle sweetness and bitterness.
desc.Maeun-tang: Maeuntang is a hot and spicy Korean fish stew made by boiling pieces of fresh fish with gochujang, chili powder, and vegetables such as radish, onion, watercress, and sometimes zucchini or tofu. It is served bubbling hot with a bold, fiery chili taste.
desc.Muffin: A muffin is a small, individual-sized baked quickbread or cake often made sweet with additions like blueberries or savory with cheese and cornmeal. It is baked in a cup-shaped container until golden and moist inside.
desc.Shrimp toast: Shrimp toast is a Cantonese dim sum appetizer made from small triangles of bread spread with a minced shrimp paste and then baked or deep-fried until crispy. It is often topped with sesame seeds and served hot with a savory, slightly sweet seafood flavor.
desc.Menchi-katsu: Menchi-katsu is a Japanese breaded and deep-fried ground meat patty, usually made from beef, pork, or a mixture of the two. It is served hot and crispy, often in bento boxes or as a sandwich filling with a juicy, meaty taste.
desc.Mochi: Mochi is a soft, chewy Japanese rice cake made by steaming and pounding glutinous rice into a smooth paste that is then molded into shapes. It has a mild, subtly sweet flavor and a distinctive elastic texture.
desc.Motsunabe: Motsunabe is a Japanese hot pot stew made by simmering beef or pork offal with cabbage, garlic chives, and a soy or miso-based broth flavored with garlic and chili. It is served bubbling at the table and often finished with noodles for a savory, rich taste.
desc.Mojito: A mojito is a Cuban cocktail made with white rum, fresh lime juice, sugar, soda water, and muddled mint leaves. It is served chilled and refreshing with a balanced sweet, citrusy, and herbaceous mint flavor.
desc.Minestrone: Minestrone is a thick Italian vegetable soup containing a mixture of chopped vegetables such as onions, carrots, celery, tomatoes, and often beans or pasta. It is simmered until tender and served hot with a hearty, savory taste.
desc.Milmyeon: Milmyeon is a Korean noodle dish featuring wheat noodles served either in a cold meat broth or tossed in a spicy sauce and topped with vegetables. It offers a chewy texture with refreshing or fiery flavors depending on the style.
desc.Milk tea: Milk tea is a beverage combining tea with milk, often sweetened and sometimes spiced, that can be served hot or cold. It has a creamy, smooth texture with a balanced flavor of tea and milk.
desc.Dim sum: Dim sum consists of a wide variety of small Chinese dishes traditionally served in restaurants for brunch, often with tea. They include items like steamed dumplings filled with shrimp, pork or vegetables, buns, rolls, and other bite-sized portions made from ingredients such as rice flour, wheat starch, or dough, typically prepared by steaming, frying, or baking to create tender, savory, or sweet flavors.
desc.Tteokguk: Tteokguk is a Korean soup featuring a clear broth with thinly sliced rice cakes as the main ingredient. It is usually garnished with julienned eggs, meat, seaweed, and sesame oil, resulting in a comforting, mildly savory taste from the soft, chewy rice cakes in the seasoned broth.
desc.Tteok-kkochi: Tteok-kkochi consists of skewered rice cakes that are fried until crispy on the outside. They are then brushed with a spicy gochujang-based sauce, offering a chewy texture with a sweet, spicy, and savory flavor profile.
desc.Tteokbokki: Tteokbokki is a Korean dish of small cylindrical rice cakes simmered in a thick, spicy gochujang sauce. It is commonly combined with fish cakes, boiled eggs, and scallions, delivering a chewy texture and bold, sweet-spicy taste; non-spicy versions use a soy-based sauce instead.
desc.Tom yum: Tom yum is a hot and sour Thai soup made by boiling ingredients like lemongrass, kaffir lime leaves, galangal, chilies, and lime juice in broth. It typically includes shrimp, chicken, or other proteins and mushrooms, resulting in a fragrant, spicy, and tangy broth with balanced savory and citrus notes.
desc.Tom yum kung: Tom yum kung is a Thai spicy and sour shrimp soup featuring shrimp as the main ingredient, infused with lemongrass, kaffir lime leaves, galangal, chilies, and lime juice. It comes in clear or creamy versions, delivering a bold, aromatic broth that is hot, tangy, and savory, often served with rice.
desc.Ramen: Ramen is a Japanese noodle dish featuring alkaline wheat noodles served in hot broth flavored with soy sauce, miso, or pork bone. It is topped with ingredients like sliced pork, seaweed, bamboo shoots, fish cake, and scallions, offering a rich, savory, and umami-packed taste with chewy noodles.
desc.Rabokki: Rabokki is a Korean street food combining rice cakes and instant ramen noodles stir-fried in a spicy gochujang sauce. It often includes fish cakes and boiled eggs, resulting in a chewy and springy texture with a sweet, fiery, and savory flavor.
desc.Ravioli: Ravioli are Italian stuffed pasta pockets made from thin dough envelopes filled with ingredients like cheese, meat, or vegetables. They are typically boiled and served in broth or with sauce, providing a tender bite with rich, savory filling flavors.
desc.Red curry: Red curry is a Thai dish of red curry paste simmered in coconut milk with added meat such as chicken, beef, or shrimp, or tofu for vegetarian versions. It features a creamy, aromatic sauce that is spicy, slightly sweet, and richly flavored from herbs and spices.
desc.Lomo saltado: Lomo saltado is a Peruvian stir-fry combining marinated beef strips with onions, tomatoes, and french fries. It is typically served with rice, delivering a savory, slightly tangy taste from soy and vinegar with tender meat and crisp vegetables.
desc.Long black: A long black is a coffee drink made by pouring a double shot of espresso into hot water. It results in a strong, full-bodied black coffee with pronounced crema, offering a robust and slightly bitter taste without milk.
desc.Ristretto: A ristretto is a highly concentrated espresso shot made with the same amount of ground coffee as a standard espresso but extracted using half the water, resulting in about 20 ml of intensely flavored liquid. It tastes bold, rich, and less bitter than a regular espresso due to its shorter extraction time.
desc.Garlic bread: Garlic bread consists of crusty bread slices or a partially sliced loaf like a baguette topped with garlic, butter, and often herbs such as oregano or parsley, sometimes including cheese. It is grilled or baked until toasted, offering a crispy, garlicky, and buttery flavor.
desc.Mala xiang guo: Mala xiang guo is a spicy stir-fried dish prepared in a wok with a mala seasoning blend of Sichuan pepper and chili, typically including a mix of meats, vegetables, and other ingredients chosen by the customer. It is stir-fried with seasonings to create a salty, numbing, and fiery hot taste.
desc.Malatang: Malatang is a Sichuan street food where customers select skewered or loose meats, vegetables, and noodles that are briefly simmered in a numbing and spicy broth flavored with Sichuan pepper and dried chili. It is served hot with the broth's signature tingling, fiery heat.
desc.Chongqing hot pot: Chongqing hot pot is a communal dish featuring various meats, sausages, offal, and vegetables cooked in a spicy, mala-flavored broth at the table. Diners dip the cooked pieces in sesame oil before eating, resulting in a numbing, hot, and savory taste.
desc.Pizza Margherita: Pizza Margherita is a classic Neapolitan pizza with a thin, raised-edge crust topped with hand-crushed tomatoes, mozzarella cheese, fresh basil, and extra virgin olive oil. The dough is hand-stretched and baked in a hot oven, yielding a simple, fresh, and balanced savory flavor.
desc.Macaron: A macaron is a delicate French meringue-based cookie made from egg whites, almond meal, and sugars, baked into smooth, colorful shells with a ruffled foot. It is typically sandwiched with a filling like ganache, buttercream, or jam and has a mildly moist texture that melts in the mouth with various sweet or savory flavors.
desc.Martini (cocktail): A martini is a classic cocktail made by mixing gin and vermouth, then garnished with an olive or a lemon twist. It is served chilled in a distinctive V-shaped glass and offers a crisp, dry, and botanical taste.
desc.Mapo tofu: Mapo tofu is a Sichuan dish of soft tofu cubes simmered in a thin, oily, bright red spicy sauce made with fermented broad bean chili paste, fermented black beans, and minced beef. It is served hot with a numbing, fiery, and savory flavor.
desc.Makgeolli: Makgeolli is a lightly sparkling Korean rice wine with a milky, off-white appearance and slight viscosity from chalky sediment. It has a low alcohol content and tastes slightly sweet, tangy, bitter, and astringent.
desc.Mak-guksu: Mak-guksu is a Korean noodle dish featuring buckwheat noodles served in a chilled broth or kimchi soup, often accompanied by sugar, mustard, sesame oil, or vinegar. The cold preparation gives it a refreshing, chewy texture with tangy and spicy notes.
desc.Makchang: Makchang is a Korean grilled dish made from the abomasum of cattle or the rectum of pigs, often served with a light doenjang sauce and chopped scallions. It is grilled until crispy and chewy with a rich, savory flavor.
desc.Mandu: Mandu are Korean dumplings that can be steamed, boiled, pan-fried, or deep-fried, filled with various ingredients like meat and vegetables. They have a tender wrapper and juicy, savory filling depending on the cooking method.
desc.Baguette: A baguette is a long, thin loaf of bread with a crisp, golden crust and a light, airy interior made from basic lean dough of flour, water, yeast, and salt. It is shaped by hand and baked directly on the oven floor or a stone, typically served fresh and warm in restaurants and cafés, often sliced for sandwiches or alongside meals, where it offers a satisfying crunch followed by a soft chew.
desc.Basque cheesecake: Basque cheesecake is a crustless cheesecake with a deeply caramelized, almost burnt top and a rich, creamy, custard-like center. It is made by baking a simple mixture of cream cheese, sugar, eggs, and heavy cream at high temperatures in a lined pan, resulting in a jiggly, melt-in-your-mouth texture when served slightly warm or at room temperature in restaurants and cafés.
desc.Baozi: Baozi are soft, fluffy, yeast-leavened steamed buns filled with various savory or sweet ingredients such as minced pork, vegetables, or red bean paste. Made from wheat flour dough that is wrapped around the filling and steamed until pillowy, they are commonly served hot in Chinese restaurants and cafés as a breakfast, snack, or dim sum item with a tender, slightly chewy bite.
desc.Bánh xèo: Bánh xèo is a crispy, savory Vietnamese rice crepe made from a thin batter of rice flour, water, and turmeric that is poured into a hot skillet to create a sizzling, lacy edge. It is stuffed with pork, shrimp, bean sprouts, and green onions, then folded and served hot with fresh herbs, lettuce, and pickled vegetables for wrapping, delivering a crunchy yet soft texture with savory and slightly earthy flavors.
desc.Baklava: Baklava is a sweet layered pastry made of thin sheets of filo dough filled with chopped nuts such as pistachios or walnuts and soaked in sugar syrup or honey. It is baked until golden and crisp, then cut into diamond or square pieces, offering a flaky, buttery crunch with sticky sweetness when served in restaurants and cafés.
desc.Bubble tea: Bubble tea is a refreshing drink consisting of tea mixed with milk or fruit flavors and chewy tapioca pearls, often called boba. It is prepared by brewing tea, sweetening it, adding milk or syrups, and topping with the cooked black or colored pearls, served cold over ice in cafés with a thick straw for sipping the soft, bouncy pearls alongside the creamy or fruity liquid.
desc.Bagel: A bagel is a dense, chewy bread roll shaped like a ring with a browned, sometimes crisp crust. It is made from yeasted wheat dough that is boiled briefly before baking, resulting in a doughy interior; it is often topped with seeds or salt and served sliced with cream cheese or as a sandwich base in restaurants and cafés, providing a satisfying chewy texture.
desc.Belgian waffle: A Belgian waffle is a light, airy waffle with deep pockets and larger squares, made from a yeast-leavened or baking-powder batter that is cooked in a specialized iron. It is typically served warm in restaurants and cafés for breakfast or dessert, topped with whipped cream, fruit, chocolate, syrup, or ice cream, yielding a crisp exterior and fluffy interior with a mildly sweet, buttery taste.
desc.Bossam: Bossam is a Korean dish of thinly sliced boiled pork belly, often seasoned with spices during simmering. It is served in restaurants with an array of accompaniments including ssamjang, raw garlic, kimchi, and fresh lettuce or perilla leaves so diners can wrap the tender, savory meat in the greens for a fresh, juicy, and mildly spicy bite.
desc.Budae-jjigae: Budae jjigae is a spicy Korean stew combining a flavorful broth with ingredients like ham, sausage, Spam, kimchi, instant noodles, and American cheese. Simmered together in a large pot until bubbling and melded, it is served communal-style in restaurants as a hearty, comforting anju with a bold, savory, and fiery taste from gochujang and the mix of processed meats and fermented cabbage.
desc.Burrata: Burrata is a fresh Italian cheese made by encasing a creamy filling of stracciatella and clotted cream inside a thin outer shell of mozzarella. Produced from cow's or buffalo milk, it is served at room temperature in restaurants and cafés, often with olive oil, salt, and accompaniments like tomatoes or bread, providing a delicate, milky exterior that yields to a rich, oozing, luscious center.
desc.Burrito: A burrito is a Mexican dish consisting of a large flour tortilla wrapped around a filling of ingredients such as rice, beans, meat, cheese, and salsa. It is typically assembled by folding the sides and rolling tightly, then served warm in restaurants, sometimes grilled for a crisp exterior, offering a hearty combination of soft tortilla with varied savory, spicy, and creamy textures and flavors inside.
desc.Samosa: A samosa is a fried turnover with a savory filling of spiced potatoes, onions, and peas, though it may contain paneer, meat, or fish. It is shaped into a triangle, cone, or crescent, deep-fried until crisp, and typically served hot with chutney.
desc.Sashimi: Sashimi is a Japanese dish of fresh raw fish or meat sliced into thin pieces. It is served cold, often with soy sauce for dipping, highlighting the delicate, clean taste of the seafood.
desc.San-nakji: San-nakji is a Korean raw dish of small octopus cut into small pieces and served immediately. The pieces often continue to move on the plate due to lingering nerve activity and are eaten with a spicy dipping sauce for a chewy, fresh taste.
desc.Salsa verde: Salsa verde is a spicy Mexican green sauce made from tomatillos and green chili peppers, blended or simmered together. It is served as a condiment or topping with dishes like enchiladas, offering a bright, tangy, and fiery flavor.
desc.Samgye-tang: Samgyetang is a Korean soup featuring a whole young chicken stuffed with garlic, rice, jujube, mung beans, and ginseng, then simmered in broth. It is served hot as a nourishing, savory dish with tender meat and aromatic flavors.
desc.Fried shrimp: Shrimp fritter, also known as fried shrimp, consists of shrimp that are battered or breaded and then deep-fried or pan-fried until golden and crispy. It is served hot, often with dipping sauces, delivering a crunchy exterior and juicy, sweet seafood inside.
desc.Sandwich: A sandwich is a dish made with meat, cheese, sauces, and vegetables placed between slices of bread or atop a single slice as an open sandwich. It is assembled cold or toasted and offers varied savory flavors and textures depending on the fillings.
desc.Salad: A salad is a dish of mixed ingredients, often raw vegetables like lettuce, tomatoes, and cucumbers, tossed together and served chilled. It is typically dressed with savory sauces, providing a fresh, crisp taste and varied textures.
desc.Draught beer: Draft beer is beer served from a cask or pressurized keg rather than a bottle or can. It is poured fresh into a glass, often with a foamy head, delivering a crisp, carbonated taste straight from the tap.
desc.Shawarma: Shawarma is a Middle Eastern street food of thinly sliced meat stacked on a vertical spit and roasted slowly. The shaved meat is served hot in flatbread with vegetables and sauces, offering juicy, spiced flavors with a smoky char.
desc.Seonjit-guk: Seonjit-guk is a Korean soup made with coagulated cow blood, bone broth, tripe, and napa cabbage, simmered together. It is served hot as a rich, savory, and iron-rich dish with a hearty, comforting taste.
desc.Seolleongtang: Seolleongtang is a Korean soup with a milky off-white, cloudy appearance made by simmering ox bones, brisket, and other cuts over low heat for hours to extract flavor. It is served hot and seasoned at the table with salt, black pepper, red pepper, garlic, or spring onions, then eaten with rice and side dishes.
desc.Ceviche: Ceviche is a cold dish of raw fish or shellfish marinated in citrus juices along with seasonings. The acid in the citrus cures the seafood, giving it a firm texture and bright, tangy flavor.
desc.Salt bread: Salt bread is a buttery Japanese roll made by wrapping dough around butter, which steams during baking to create a hollow interior and crispy base. It has a lightly salted flavor and may be served plain or with sweet or savory fillings like custard, cheese, or mochi.
desc.Soba: Soba are Japanese noodles made primarily from buckwheat flour, giving them an ashen brown color and slightly grainy texture. They are served either chilled with a dipping sauce or hot in a noodle soup.
desc.Soju: Soju is a clear, colorless Korean distilled spirit with a neutral flavor similar to vodka, typically made from rice or other starches. It is usually consumed neat at varying alcohol strengths, most commonly below 20% ABV.
desc.Shortcake: Shortcake is a crumbly, scone-like dessert typically served with fruit and cream. Popular versions like strawberry shortcake feature sweetened biscuits layered or topped with fresh strawberries and whipped cream.
desc.Thai suki: Thai suki is a communal hot pot dish where diners cook meat, seafood, noodles, dumplings, and vegetables in a simmering broth at the table, then dip them in a spicy sauce before eating. The broth is savory and the ingredients are cooked to tender perfection.
desc.Sujebi: Sujebi is a Korean soup featuring hand-torn wheat dough flakes simmered in a rich broth made from anchovies, shellfish, and kelp, along with vegetables like zucchini and potatoes. The soft, chewy flakes and umami broth create a comforting, savory taste.
desc.Soufflé: A soufflé is a light, airy baked egg dish that can be savory or sweet. It is made by folding beaten egg whites into a flavored base of yolks, milk or cream, and other ingredients, then baking until it puffs up with a delicate, fluffy texture.
desc.Supplì: Supplì are Italian fried rice balls, typically made from risotto mixed with tomato sauce and mozzarella, then breaded and deep-fried. They have a crispy exterior and gooey, savory interior with a rich, tomatoey flavor.
desc.Sundae: A sundae is a frozen dessert consisting of scoops of ice cream topped with sweet sauces, whipped cream, and various toppings like sprinkles, cherries, nuts, or fruit. It offers a creamy, cold texture with contrasting sweet and crunchy elements.
desc.Sundubu-jjigae: Sundubu jjigae is a Korean stew made with extra-soft unpressed tofu, vegetables, optional seafood or meat, and gochujang or gochugaru in a spicy, bubbling broth. It is cooked and served in a hot stone or porcelain pot, often with a raw egg added at the end for richness.
desc.Schnitzel: Schnitzel is a thin slice of meat, usually veal, pork, chicken, beef or turkey, that is pounded flat with a tenderizer, coated in breadcrumbs, and pan-fried until golden and crisp. It has a crunchy breading on the outside with tender, juicy meat inside.
desc.Smash burger: A smash burger is a hamburger made by pressing a ball of ground beef firmly onto a hot griddle or skillet to form a thin patty with crispy, browned edges. It features a savory crust from the Maillard reaction while the interior stays juicy, and is typically served on a bun with toppings.
desc.Smoothie: A smoothie is a thick, blended beverage made by puréeing fruits, vegetables, or other ingredients with a liquid base such as fruit juice, milk, or yogurt, often including ice, sweeteners, or supplements. It has a creamy, smooth texture and refreshing taste that varies with the chosen ingredients.
desc.Sushi: Sushi is a Japanese dish consisting of vinegared rice combined with ingredients such as raw or cooked seafood, vegetables, or meat. It is typically formed into shapes like hand-pressed nigiri or rolled maki, with a balanced taste of tangy rice and fresh, delicate toppings.
desc.Scone: A scone is a baked good made from wheat flour or oatmeal, leavened with baking powder, and sometimes lightly sweetened or savoury. It has a tender, crumbly texture, is often split and topped with cream or jam for afternoon tea, and tastes mildly buttery.
desc.Sukiyaki: Sukiyaki is a Japanese hot pot dish of thinly sliced beef and vegetables simmered at the table in a shallow pot with a sweet-savory broth of soy sauce, sugar, and mirin. The cooked ingredients are dipped in raw beaten egg before eating, resulting in tender meat and vegetables with rich, umami flavor.
desc.Steak: Steak is a thick cut of meat, most often beef, sliced across the muscle fibers and typically grilled or fried. It has a seared exterior and juicy interior, with a rich, savory taste that varies by cut and doneness.
desc.Steak tartare: Steak tartare is a dish of raw, ground or minced beef mixed or served with seasonings like onions, capers, parsley, salt, pepper, and Worcestershire sauce. It is often topped with a raw egg yolk and has a tender, fresh taste with tangy and savory notes.
desc.Spaghetti: Spaghetti is long, thin, cylindrical pasta made from durum wheat semolina and water. It is boiled until al dente and typically served with sauce, offering a firm texture and mild wheat flavor that pairs well with various toppings.
desc.Savory spinach pie: Spanakopita is a savory Greek pastry filled with chopped spinach, feta or white cheese, and egg, wrapped in layers of phyllo dough and baked until golden and flaky. It has a crisp, buttery crust with a creamy, earthy spinach and tangy cheese filling.
desc.Caesar salad: Caesar salad is a green salad of romaine lettuce and croutons dressed with a creamy mixture of lemon juice, olive oil, egg, anchovies, garlic, mustard, Parmesan cheese, and black pepper. It is tossed together for a crisp, tangy, and savory flavor with umami depth.
desc.Sicilian pizza: Sicilian pizza is a thick-crusted, rectangular pizza topped with tomatoes, herbs, onions, anchovies, and strong cheeses like caciocavallo. It is baked until the crust is crisp on the bottom and chewy, with a robust, savory taste from its simple toppings.
desc.Shin Ramyun: Shin Ramyun is a spicy instant noodle dish consisting of wavy wheat noodles, a savory-spicy seasoning packet, and dehydrated vegetable flakes, prepared by boiling in water. It has a chewy texture and bold, fiery broth with garlic, chili, and beef flavor.
desc.Sinseollo: Sinseollo is a Korean royal hot pot of meatballs, small fish pancakes, mushrooms, and vegetables simmered in a rich, clear broth. It is served in a special central-heated vessel and offers a delicate, savory taste with tender ingredients in flavorful soup.
desc.Bun cha: Bun cha is a Vietnamese dish of grilled fatty pork served over a plate of white rice noodles and fresh herbs, accompanied by a sweet-tangy dipping sauce. The pork is marinated, grilled until caramelized and smoky, then combined with the noodles and sauce at the table for a harmonious balance of savory, fresh, and slightly sweet flavors.
desc.Bulgogi: Bulgogi consists of thin slices of beef, typically sirloin or rib eye, marinated in a sweet-savory sauce of soy, sugar, garlic, and sesame, then grilled quickly on a barbecue or griddle until tender and caramelized. It offers a juicy, smoky-sweet taste with a hint of nuttiness from the sesame.
desc.Bungeo-ppang: Bungeo-ppang is a warm, fish-shaped pastry with a crisp golden exterior and soft interior, filled most commonly with sweetened red bean paste or sometimes pastry cream. It is grilled in a special mold and eaten as a sweet, comforting street snack with a mildly nutty, subtly sweet flavor.
desc.Bratwurst: Bratwurst is a coarse-textured German sausage made primarily from pork, sometimes mixed with beef or veal, seasoned with spices like nutmeg and coriander. It is typically pan-fried, grilled, or simmered and served hot, offering a juicy, savory, mildly spiced flavor.
desc.Bruschetta: Bruschetta is grilled or toasted bread rubbed with garlic, drizzled with olive oil and salt, then topped with mixtures such as chopped tomatoes, vegetables, beans, cured meats, or cheese. It is served as a crisp, garlicky appetizer with bright, fresh, or savory toppings that complement the olive-oil richness.
desc.Wiener schnitzel: Wiener schnitzel is a thin veal cutlet coated in breadcrumbs and pan-fried in butter or oil until golden and crisp. It is traditionally served hot with a squeeze of lemon, delivering a tender, juicy interior encased in a light, crunchy crust.
desc.Biryani: Biryani is a fragrant rice dish layered with spiced meat, seafood, or vegetables, cooked slowly so the rice absorbs aromatic spices, herbs, and juices. It is served steaming hot, with tender proteins, fluffy grains, and a complex blend of savory, spicy, and floral flavors.
desc.Bibimbap: Bibimbap is a Korean rice bowl topped with an array of sautéed or blanched seasoned vegetables, gochujang chili paste, a fried egg, and often sliced beef, all mixed together just before eating. The combination yields a harmonious taste of nutty rice, earthy vegetables, sweet-spicy sauce, and rich egg or meat.
desc.Vichyssoise: Vichyssoise is a smooth, creamy soup of puréed leeks, potatoes, onions, and heavy cream, served well chilled and garnished with chopped chives. It has a delicate, velvety texture and a mild, subtly sweet onion-like flavor that is refreshing and elegant.
desc.Big Mac: The Big Mac is a double-patty hamburger on a three-part sesame seed bun, layered with American cheese, shredded lettuce, pickles, minced onions, and a tangy special sauce reminiscent of Thousand Island dressing. It is assembled and served hot, delivering a juicy, savory, crunchy, and slightly sweet bite.
desc.Bindae-tteok: Bindaetteok is a savory Korean pancake made from ground soaked mung beans mixed with vegetables and meat, then pan-fried until crisp and golden on the outside. It has a hearty, earthy flavor with a satisfying crunchy exterior and soft, moist interior.
desc.Bingsu: Bingsu is a Korean shaved ice dessert made with finely shaved frozen milk or ice, topped with sweet red beans, chopped fruit, condensed milk, fruit syrup, rice cakes, or other sweet elements. It is served cold and fluffy, tasting refreshingly light, creamy, and subtly sweet.
desc.Green papaya salad: Green papaya salad is a spicy salad made from shredded unripe papaya that is typically mixed with ingredients like lime juice, fish sauce, chili, garlic, and sometimes tomatoes or peanuts for added flavor and crunch.
desc.Agwi-jjim: Agwi-jjim is a Korean braised spicy angler fish dish seasoned with hot chili powder, doenjang, soy sauce, garlic, and scallions, often including soybean sprouts, sea squirt, and water parsley for a refreshing and fragrant taste with a chewy texture.
desc.Adana kebabı: Adana kebab consists of a long strip of hand-minced lamb meat mixed with tail fat, mounted on a wide skewer and grilled over charcoal, resulting in a juicy, spicy, and flavorful kebab.
desc.Arancini: Arancini are Italian rice balls stuffed with fillings like ragù, mozzarella, and peas, coated in breadcrumbs and deep-fried until golden and crispy on the outside with a creamy, savory interior.
desc.Arepa: Arepa is a flatbread made from ground maize dough that can be grilled, baked, or fried and is often stuffed or served with fillings like cheese, meat, or avocado for a savory taste.
desc.Aburasoba: Aburasoba is a dry Japanese noodle dish mixed with a sauce of soy sauce and lard, typically topped with menma, nori, green onions, and sometimes raw garlic or egg, creating a rich, savory, and aromatic flavor when tossed together.
desc.Einspänner: Einspänner is a Viennese coffee drink made with espresso topped with a layer of whipped cream, traditionally served in a glass for a smooth, strong coffee taste balanced by the creamy sweetness.
desc.Affogato: Affogato is an Italian dessert consisting of a scoop of vanilla or milk-flavored gelato topped with hot espresso, creating a contrast of creamy cold sweetness with bitter, intense coffee flavor.
desc.Andong jjimdak: Andong jjimdak is a Korean steamed chicken dish made with chicken and various vegetables marinated and cooked in a ganjang-based sauce, resulting in tender, savory, and slightly sweet flavors.
desc.Antipasto: Antipasto is an Italian starter course consisting of a platter of small bite-sized portions such as cheeses, cured meats, olives, and vegetables, served to stimulate the appetite with a variety of savory flavors and textures.
desc.Yakisoba: Yakisoba is a Japanese stir-fried noodle dish made with wheat flour noodles flavored with a Worcestershire-like sauce, often including vegetables and meat, resulting in a savory, slightly sweet, and tangy taste.
desc.Yakitori: Yakitori is Japanese grilled chicken on skewers cooked over charcoal and seasoned with either tare sauce or salt, offering a juicy, smoky, and savory flavor.
desc.Janchi-guksu: Janchi-guksu is a Korean noodle dish of thin wheat somyeon noodles served in a light, clear anchovy or kelp broth, often topped with a sesame-soy sauce, fried egg strips, gim, zucchini, and scallions. It has a delicate savory flavor with subtle umami from the broth and a fresh, light taste from the garnishes.
desc.Japchae: Japchae is a Korean stir-fried dish of sweet potato glass noodles mixed with vegetables, meat, and mushrooms, seasoned with soy sauce and sesame oil. It offers a savory and slightly sweet taste with a chewy noodle texture and tender, flavorful ingredients.
desc.Gelato: Gelato is an Italian-style frozen dessert made with milk, cream, sugar, and flavorings like fruit, nuts, or chocolate, churned with less air than regular ice cream for a dense, rich texture. It has an intense, creamy flavor that is smoother and more pronounced than typical ice cream.
desc.Jumeok-bap: Jumeok-bap consists of cooked rice shaped into round, fist-sized balls, often mixed or filled with ingredients like vegetables, seaweed, or seasoned meat. It is served as a portable snack or side, with a chewy, savory taste that pairs well with spicy dishes.
desc.Jeungpyeon: Jeungpyeon is a light, fluffy Korean rice cake made by steaming fermented rice flour dough with makgeolli, resulting in a slightly sweet and mildly alcoholic flavor. It has a soft, airy texture often enjoyed plain or with added fillings.
desc.Gin and tonic: A gin and tonic is a cocktail of gin and tonic water served over ice, typically garnished with a lime wedge. It tastes crisp, bitter, and refreshing with botanical notes from the gin balanced by the quinine in the tonic.
desc.Jjajangmyeon: Jjajangmyeon is a Korean-Chinese noodle dish of wheat noodles topped with a thick, dark sauce made from chunjang, diced pork, and vegetables. It has a savory, slightly sweet umami flavor with a hearty, comforting taste.
desc.Chả giò: Cha gio, or Vietnamese fried spring rolls, are made by wrapping ground pork and vegetables in rice paper then deep-frying until crispy. They are served as appetizers with a crunchy exterior, savory filling, and often dipped in nuoc cham for a fresh, tangy contrast.
desc.Jjamppong: Jjamppong is a spicy Korean-Chinese noodle soup featuring a red broth flavored with chili powder and seafood or pork, along with vegetables like onions, zucchini, and cabbage. It has a bold, fiery, and savory taste with chewy noodles and tender ingredients.
desc.Jjolmyeon: Jjolmyeon is a cold Korean dish of chewy wheat-starch noodles mixed with vegetables like cabbage and bean sprouts in a spicy-sweet sauce of gochujang, vinegar, sugar, and garlic. It delivers a refreshing, tangy heat with a bouncy texture.
desc.Mutton curry: Mutton curry is a savory dish of tender goat or lamb meat simmered with vegetables in a spiced sauce made from onions, tomatoes, garlic, ginger, and a blend of aromatic spices. It is typically slow-cooked until the meat is very tender and served hot with rice or Indian flatbreads.
desc.Yangnyeom chicken: Yangnyeom chicken is Korean fried chicken coated in a glossy sweet and spicy sauce made from gochujang, garlic, sugar, and other seasonings. The chicken is double-fried for extra crispiness and then tossed in the sauce, resulting in a crunchy, sticky, and boldly flavored dish often enjoyed as a snack or with drinks.
desc.Onion ring: Onion rings are rings of onion dipped in batter or breadcrumbs and deep-fried until golden and crispy. They have a savory, slightly sweet onion flavor inside a crunchy coating and are typically served hot as a side dish or appetizer, often with dipping sauce.
desc.Fishcake: Fishcakes are made by mincing or grinding fish or seafood, mixing it with starchy ingredients like potato or starch, along with seasonings, then shaping and frying or baking until golden. They have a mild seafood taste with a crispy exterior and soft interior, and can be served as an appetizer or main with sauces.
desc.Eggs Benedict: Eggs Benedict consists of two halves of an English muffin topped with Canadian bacon or ham, a poached egg, and a rich hollandaise sauce. It is assembled by layering the ingredients and served warm, offering a creamy, savory, and slightly tangy flavor combination that is a breakfast or brunch classic.
desc.Éclair: An éclair is an oblong pastry made from choux dough that is baked until crisp and hollow, then filled with custard, whipped cream, or chiboust cream and topped with flavored icing or fondant. It has a light, airy texture with a sweet, creamy filling and is served as a dessert.
desc.Snails as food: Escargot refers to edible land snails, typically prepared by cooking them in garlic butter, herbs, and sometimes wine, then served hot in their shells. They have a tender, chewy texture and a rich, garlicky flavor that is often enjoyed as an appetizer in French cuisine.
desc.Espresso: Espresso is a concentrated coffee beverage made by forcing hot water under high pressure through finely ground coffee beans. It is served in a small cup, featuring a dark, intense body topped with a lighter crema foam, and has a bold, complex flavor that is slightly bitter and aromatic.
desc.Enchilada: An enchilada is a corn tortilla rolled around a filling of meat, cheese, beans, or vegetables and covered in a savory sauce such as chili-based salsa, mole, or cheese sauce. It is baked and served hot, offering a soft texture with spicy, tangy, or creamy flavors depending on the sauce.
desc.Empanada: An empanada is a turnover made by folding pastry dough over a filling of meat, cheese, vegetables, or other ingredients, then baking or frying it until golden. It has a crispy or flaky crust enclosing a savory or sometimes sweet filling and is served hot as a snack or meal.
desc.Yeonpo-tang: Yeonpo-tang is a Korean soup made by simmering beef, radish, tofu, and other ingredients in a clear kelp-based broth. It is gently cooked to highlight the natural flavors and served hot as a light, savory dish with tender meat and vegetables.
desc.Onigiri: Onigiri are Japanese rice balls made from white rice shaped into triangles or cylinders, often wrapped in nori seaweed and filled with savory ingredients like salted salmon, pickled plum, or bonito flakes. They have a soft, chewy rice texture with contrasting salty or sour fillings and are eaten by hand.
desc.Oden: Oden is a Japanese one-pot dish of various ingredients like boiled eggs, daikon radish, konjac, and processed fish balls gently stewed together in a light, savory soy-flavored dashi broth. It is typically served hot from a shared pot at restaurants or food carts, often with a dab of spicy mustard as a condiment, offering a mild, comforting, and subtly umami-rich taste.
desc.Omurice: Omurice is a Japanese dish of fried rice, often mixed with ketchup, chicken, and vegetables, topped with a soft, fluffy omelette. It is commonly served at cafés and family restaurants, sometimes with the omelette split open to reveal the rice inside, delivering a comforting blend of savory rice and mild, creamy egg.
desc.Osam-bulgogi: Osam-bulgogi is a Korean stir-fried dish combining squid and pork belly with vegetables and mushrooms in a spicy-sweet red pepper sauce. It is typically cooked and served sizzling on a griddle at restaurants, resulting in tender seafood, rich fatty meat, and intensely flavorful, vibrant red bites.
desc.Okonomiyaki: Okonomiyaki is a Japanese savory pancake made from a wheat flour batter mixed with shredded cabbage, meat or seafood, and other ingredients, cooked on a flat griddle. It is topped with a sweet-savory sauce, mayonnaise, bonito flakes, and seaweed, offering a crispy exterior with a soft, umami-packed interior, commonly served at specialized restaurants.
desc.Whopper: The Whopper is a signature flame-grilled hamburger from Burger King, featuring a large beef patty with lettuce, tomato, pickles, onion, ketchup, and mayonnaise on a sesame seed bun. It is served hot and juicy at fast-food restaurants, delivering a classic savory, tangy, and slightly smoky burger taste.
desc.Waffle: A waffle is a leavened batter cooked between patterned plates to create a crisp, grid-textured cake. It is commonly served hot at cafés, often topped with butter, syrup, or fruit, providing a sweet, fluffy interior with a crunchy exterior.
desc.Udon: Udon are thick, chewy wheat flour noodles served in a mild dashi-based broth with soy sauce and mirin. At restaurants they are commonly enjoyed hot in soup topped with scallions, tempura, or fish cake, offering a simple, comforting, and subtly savory flavor.
desc.Yukgaejang: Yukgaejang is a spicy Korean beef soup made by simmering shredded beef with scallions, bean sprouts, fernbrake, and other vegetables in a chili-powdered broth. It is served steaming hot at restaurants, with a bold, fiery, and deeply savory taste that warms the palate.
desc.Jamón ibérico: Jamón ibérico is a Spanish cured ham made from the hind leg of Black Iberian pigs. It is thinly sliced and served at room temperature in restaurants and tapas bars, offering a rich, melt-in-the-mouth texture with intense, nutty, and savory flavor.
desc.Injeolmi: Injeolmi is a Korean rice cake made from steamed and pounded glutinous rice, shaped into pieces and coated with powdered beans or sesame. It is served at cafés or as a snack, with a soft, chewy texture and mildly sweet, nutty taste from the coating.
desc.Sauerkraut: Sauerkraut is finely shredded white cabbage that has been fermented by lactic acid bacteria. It is commonly served as a tangy side dish or topping in restaurants and cafés, with a distinctive sour flavor and crisp texture.
desc.Coq au vin: Coq au vin is a French dish of chicken braised with red wine, lardons, mushrooms, and optionally garlic. It is slowly simmered until the chicken is tender and the sauce is rich and deeply flavorful.
desc.Corn dog: A corn dog is a hot dog sausage on a stick coated in a thick layer of cornmeal batter and deep fried until golden and crisp. It is served hot, often with mustard or ketchup, offering a savory sausage center with a sweet, crunchy exterior.
desc.Corn cheese: Corn cheese is a dish made of sweet corn kernels combined with melted mozzarella cheese. It is typically baked or pan-fried until the cheese is bubbly and golden, resulting in a creamy, savory, and slightly sweet flavor.
desc.Crème brûlée: Crème brûlée is a dessert consisting of a rich vanilla custard base topped with a layer of hardened caramelized sugar. It is served chilled, providing a contrast between the brittle, bittersweet caramel crust and the smooth, creamy custard beneath.
desc.Crème caramel: Crème caramel is a custard dessert with a smooth, creamy texture and a layer of clear caramel sauce on top. It is gently baked in a water bath and inverted for serving so the caramel flows over the custard.
desc.Croffle: A croffle is a hybrid pastry made by cooking croissant dough in a waffle iron. It results in a crispy, flaky exterior with a buttery, chewy interior, often served sweet with toppings like fruit or chocolate.
desc.Croissant: A croissant is a buttery, flaky pastry made from laminated yeast-leavened dough that is rolled, folded, and baked until golden. It has a crisp exterior and airy, layered interior with a rich, buttery taste.
desc.Cream bun: A cream bun is an enriched bread roll that is split after baking and filled with whipped cream or pastry cream. It is soft and slightly sweet, with a creamy filling that makes it a light, indulgent treat.
desc.Cream soup: Cream soup is a smooth soup made with a base of milk, cream, or half-and-half thickened with flour and butter. It incorporates vegetables or meats for flavor, resulting in a rich, velvety texture and mild, comforting taste.
desc.Club sandwich: A club sandwich is a multi-layered sandwich made with toasted bread, sliced poultry, bacon, lettuce, tomato, and mayonnaise. It is typically cut into quarters and held with toothpicks, offering a hearty, savory combination of flavors and textures.
desc.Tart: A tart is a baked open-faced pastry with a shortcrust base and a filling that may be sweet or savory. It is often fruit-based with custard, providing a crisp crust and creamy or juicy center.
desc.Tzatziki: Tzatziki is a cold dip, soup, or sauce made from salted strained yogurt mixed with cucumbers, garlic, olive oil, vinegar or lemon juice, and herbs like dill or mint. It is served as a refreshing meze appetizer, side dish, or sauce for grilled meats and sandwiches, with a creamy, tangy, and garlicky taste.
desc.Choripán: Choripán is a grilled chorizo sausage sandwich served in a crusty bread roll, popular as street food and at barbecues. It features a smoky, spicy pork sausage in bread, often accompanied by chimichurri or salsa, delivering a savory and flavorful bite.
desc.Chocolate cake: Chocolate cake is a rich cake flavored with melted chocolate or cocoa powder, sometimes layered with fudge or vanilla cream. It is baked until moist and tender, then often frosted with chocolate icing for a sweet, deep cocoa taste.
desc.Cheeseburger: A cheeseburger is a grilled or fried beef patty topped with melted cheese, served in a bun with possible additions like lettuce, tomato, and ketchup. It is commonly offered in fast-food restaurants as a savory, juicy sandwich with gooey cheese.
desc.Cheesecake: Cheesecake is a dessert with a creamy filling made from soft fresh cheese, sugar, and eggs or cream, set on a crumbly cookie or biscuit base. It is baked or chilled until smooth and rich, offering a dense, tangy-sweet flavor and velvety texture, often served plain or flavored.
desc.Chicharrón: Chicharrón consists of crispy fried pork belly or pork rinds, deep-fried until golden and crunchy. It is served as a snack or topping, with a savory, salty taste and satisfying crackling texture.
desc.Chicken nugget: Chicken nuggets are small pieces of deboned chicken meat that are breaded or battered and then deep-fried or baked until golden and crisp. They are a popular fast-food item, mild in flavor with a crunchy exterior and tender chicken inside, often served with dipping sauces.
desc.Chili dog: A chili dog is a hot dog in a bun topped with a savory meat sauce like chili con carne, plus optional cheese, onions, or mustard. It is served hot in casual eateries, combining smoky sausage with spicy, hearty chili for a bold, comforting taste.
desc.Carpaccio: Carpaccio is thinly sliced raw beef, veal, or fish served as an appetizer, typically dressed with lemon, olive oil, salt, pepper, and sometimes cheese. It offers a delicate, fresh taste with tender texture and bright, simple seasonings.
desc.Khao soi: Khao soi is a rich and creamy noodle soup made with egg noodles, coconut milk, and a spiced curry broth, typically topped with crispy fried noodles, pickled vegetables, and a squeeze of lime. It is served hot in a bowl and tastes savory, mildly spicy, and aromatic with a balance of creamy and tangy flavors.
desc.Fried rice: Fried rice is a stir-fried dish made from cooked rice mixed with ingredients such as eggs, vegetables, meat, or seafood, seasoned with soy sauce and aromatics. It is served hot as a main dish and tastes savory, slightly crispy, and flavorful from the wok cooking.
desc.Latte: A cafe latte is a coffee drink made with espresso and steamed milk, creating a smooth and creamy texture. It is typically served hot in a glass or mug and tastes mildly bitter from the coffee balanced by the sweetness of the milk.
desc.Caffè mocha: A cafe mocha is a chocolate-flavored coffee drink made with espresso, steamed milk, and chocolate, often topped with whipped cream. It is served hot in a glass and tastes rich, creamy, and sweet with a balance of coffee and chocolate flavors.
desc.Cappuccino: Cappuccino is an espresso-based coffee drink prepared with steamed milk and a thick layer of milk foam on top. It is served hot and tastes strong and creamy, with the foam adding a light, airy texture and mild sweetness.
desc.Cocktail: A cocktail is a mixed alcoholic drink typically combining one or more spirits with ingredients like juices, syrups, bitters, or tonic water. It is served chilled or over ice in a variety of glasses and tastes range from sweet and fruity to bitter or savory depending on the recipe.
desc.Kal-guksu: Kalguksu is a noodle dish featuring handmade, knife-cut wheat flour noodles served in a hot broth with vegetables and sometimes meat or seafood. It is served in a large bowl and tastes light, savory, and comforting with a soft noodle texture.
desc.California roll: California roll is a type of sushi roll made with imitation crab, avocado, and cucumber, often prepared inside-out with rice on the outside sprinkled with sesame seeds or roe. It is served cold or at room temperature and tastes fresh, creamy, and mildly sweet with a crisp texture from the vegetables.
desc.Kebab: Kebab is a dish of roasted or grilled meat, often lamb, chicken, or beef, sometimes skewered with vegetables and served with sauces or bread. It is typically served hot and tastes juicy, savory, and smoky from the cooking method.
desc.Quesadilla: A quesadilla is a Mexican dish made by folding a tortilla filled with cheese, and sometimes meats or spices, then cooked on a griddle until crispy and melted. It is served hot, often cut into wedges, and tastes cheesy, savory, and slightly toasted.
desc.Cortado: A cortado is a coffee beverage made by mixing espresso with a roughly equal amount of warm steamed milk to mellow the acidity. It is served hot in a small glass and tastes smooth, balanced, and mildly creamy without foam.
desc.Taiyaki: Taiyaki is a Japanese fish-shaped cake made from batter cooked in a special mold, typically filled with sweet red bean paste called anko. It is served warm as a sweet street food snack with a soft, slightly crisp exterior and a sweet, creamy filling.
desc.Taco: A taco is a Mexican dish consisting of a small corn or wheat tortilla folded around a filling such as meat, beans, vegetables, or cheese. It is garnished with salsa, guacamole, sour cream, or fresh vegetables and eaten by hand, offering a mix of soft, crisp, spicy, and creamy textures and flavors.
desc.Takoyaki: Takoyaki are ball-shaped Japanese snacks made from a wheat flour batter cooked in a special molded pan, typically filled with diced octopus, tempura scraps, pickled ginger, and green onion. They are brushed with a sweet-savory sauce and mayonnaise, then topped with seaweed and bonito flakes, resulting in a crispy outside and soft, savory interior.
desc.Tahini: Tahini is a Middle Eastern seed butter made from ground sesame seeds, which can be roasted or raw. It is served as a dip, incorporated into dressings or dishes like hummus, with a smooth, creamy texture and a rich, nutty, slightly bitter taste.
desc.Tandoori chicken: Tandoori chicken is an Indian dish of chicken marinated in yogurt and spices then roasted in a tandoor clay oven. It is served hot with a tender, juicy texture and a smoky, spiced flavor.
desc.Tagliatelle: Tagliatelle are long, flat ribbons of egg pasta, traditionally about 6 mm wide, similar in shape to fettuccine. They are served with sauces such as meat or Bolognese, providing a tender yet slightly chewy texture that holds sauce well.
desc.Tangsuyuk: Tangsuyuk is a Korean Chinese meat dish typically made with pork or beef that is battered, deep-fried until crispy, and served with a sweet and sour sauce. It offers a contrast of crunchy exterior and tender meat with tangy, sweet flavors.
desc.Terrine: A terrine is a French loaf of forcemeat or aspic, similar to pâté, cooked in a covered mold in a bain-marie. It is served cold or at room temperature, with a rich, smooth texture and savory taste often enhanced by fat.
desc.Tortellini: Tortellini are small, ring-shaped stuffed pastas from Italy, filled with a mixture of meats, Parmesan cheese, egg, and nutmeg. They are typically served in a broth, offering a delicate, chewy pasta with a savory, meaty filling.
desc.Tortilla: A tortilla is a thin, circular unleavened flatbread made from corn or wheat flour. It is baked on a griddle and used as a soft, pliable wrap or base for various fillings and toppings, with a mild, slightly earthy or neutral taste.
desc.Tomato soup: Tomato soup is a soup made primarily with tomatoes, which can be smooth or contain chunks of tomato and other vegetables. It is served hot or cold, often with added cream or stock for a smooth, tangy, and savory flavor.
desc.Toast: Toast is sliced bread browned by radiant heat until crisp on the outside. It is commonly served warm with butter or sweet or savory toppings, providing a crunchy texture and enhanced nutty, toasty flavor.
desc.Pancake: A pancake is a flat, round cake made from a starch-based batter typically containing eggs, milk, and butter, cooked on a hot griddle or frying pan until golden. It can be thin and unleavened or thick and fluffy depending on the region, and is often served hot with sweet toppings like syrup or savory accompaniments.
desc.Pain aux raisins: Pain aux raisins is a spiral-shaped French pastry made from laminated viennoiserie dough layered with butter, filled with crème pâtissière and raisins, then baked until flaky and golden. It has a buttery, sweet taste with creamy and fruity notes, commonly enjoyed warm for breakfast.
desc.Pain au chocolat: Pain au chocolat is a rectangular French pastry made from yeast-leavened laminated dough similar to puff pastry, with one or two sticks of dark chocolate placed in the center before being rolled and baked. It features a flaky, buttery texture with a slight bite from the chocolate, often served warm.
desc.Feijoada: Feijoada is a hearty bean stew made with a mixture of white, black, or red beans simmered together with various cuts of beef and pork until tender and flavorful. It is typically served hot alongside rice, offering a rich, savory taste from the slow-cooked meats and beans.
desc.Fettuccine: Fettuccine is a flat, thick ribbon pasta made from egg and flour dough, cut to about 6.5 mm wide. It is boiled until al dente and commonly served with creamy or meat-based sauces like ragù, providing a tender texture that holds sauce well.
desc.Poke: Poke is a Hawaiian dish of diced raw fish, typically tuna, tossed in a savory sauce with ingredients like soy sauce, sesame oil, and onions. It is served chilled as an appetizer or main course, delivering fresh, umami-rich flavors with a tender texture.
desc.Pudding: Pudding in the American sense is a sweet, creamy milk-based dessert similar to a custard or mousse, often thickened with cornstarch or gelatin and flavored with vanilla or chocolate. It has a smooth, silky texture and is served chilled or at room temperature.
desc.Foie gras: Foie gras is a rich, buttery delicacy made from the enlarged liver of a duck or goose, typically prepared as a mousse, pâté, or parfait by blending or cooking the liver. It has a delicate, melt-in-the-mouth texture and is often served chilled or seared as an appetizer.
desc.Frappuccino: A Frappuccino is a blended iced beverage made with a coffee or cream base mixed with ice, flavored syrups, and often topped with whipped cream. It has a thick, slushy consistency with sweet and creamy flavors, served cold in various combinations.
desc.Pretzel: A pretzel is a baked pastry made from yeasted dough shaped into a distinctive knotted loop, briefly boiled in an alkaline solution before baking to develop a chewy, browned crust. It is typically sprinkled with coarse salt and has a savory, slightly tangy flavor with a soft interior.
desc.French toast: French toast is made by soaking slices of bread in a mixture of beaten eggs and often milk, then pan-frying until golden and crisp on the outside. It can be sweet with added vanilla, cinnamon, and toppings like syrup, or savory with salt and pepper, offering a custardy interior.
desc.Hoe-deopbap: Hoe-deopbap is a Korean dish of steamed rice topped with sliced or cubed raw fish such as halibut, tuna or salmon, along with fresh vegetables like lettuce and cucumber, then mixed at the table with sesame oil and a sweet-tangy chili sauce. It has a fresh, savory flavor with a balance of textures from the tender fish, crisp vegetables and soft rice.
desc.Hot pot: Hot pot is a communal dish featuring a simmering pot of broth placed on the table, into which diners dip thin slices of raw meat, vegetables and other ingredients to cook them quickly. The resulting food is tender and flavorful, often enjoyed with dipping sauces for added taste.
desc.Chicken sandwich: A chicken sandwich consists of a boneless chicken breast or thigh, often breaded and fried or grilled, placed between two slices of bread or on a bun and typically served with toppings like lettuce, tomato or pickles. It tastes savory and juicy with a crispy exterior when fried.
desc.Katsu curry: Curry tonkatsu is a Japanese dish of crispy breaded and fried pork cutlet served alongside Japanese rice and thick curry sauce, often cut into strips for easy eating with a spoon. It offers a satisfying contrast of crunchy coating, tender meat and mildly spiced, savory curry.
desc.Ham sandwich: A ham sandwich is made with sliced cooked ham placed between two pieces of bread, often with additions like cheese, lettuce, tomato or mustard. It tastes salty and savory with a soft, satisfying bite.
desc.Corn on the cob: Elote is grilled or boiled corn on the cob coated with mayonnaise, crumbled cheese, chili powder and lime juice. It is served warm on a stick and tastes creamy, tangy, spicy and slightly sweet.
desc.Churro: A churro is a long, ridged stick of fried choux pastry dough, often coated in cinnamon sugar and served hot. It has a crispy exterior, soft interior and a sweet, mildly spiced flavor, commonly dipped in chocolate or coffee.
desc.Open sandwich: An open sandwich consists of a single slice of bread or toast topped with various ingredients such as meats, cheeses, vegetables or spreads rather than being enclosed. It is typically eaten with a fork and knife and offers a fresh, layered combination of flavors and textures.
desc.Tiramisu: Tiramisu is an Italian dessert consisting of layers of coffee-soaked ladyfingers covered with a sweetened cream made from egg yolks, sugar, and mascarpone cheese, then dusted with cocoa powder. It is typically served chilled in a dish or individual portions and has a rich, creamy texture with a bittersweet coffee flavor.
desc.Padak: Padak is a South Korean fried chicken dish topped with scallions. It is served crispy and often accompanied by a sauce for dipping, offering a savory and slightly spicy taste.
desc.Parfait: Parfait is a layered dessert. The American version consists of alternating layers of ingredients such as granola, yogurt, nuts, liqueurs, fruits, and whipped cream, typically served in a tall glass for a creamy, crunchy, and sweet experience.
desc.Paella: Paella is a Spanish rice dish cooked with ingredients like chicken, rabbit, seafood, or vegetables in a wide shallow pan. It is served hot with a savory flavor from saffron and other seasonings, featuring a mix of tender proteins and slightly crispy rice.
desc.Pajeon: Pajeon is a Korean savory pancake made from a batter of eggs, wheat and rice flour, and prominent scallions, often including additions like beef, pork, kimchi, or seafood. It is pan-fried until crispy and golden, then sliced and served hot with a slightly chewy texture and mild onion flavor.
desc.Fajita: Fajitas are a Tex-Mex dish of grilled strips of skirt steak, chicken, shrimp, or vegetables cooked with sautéed onions and bell peppers. They are served with warm flour or corn tortillas and various condiments like sour cream, guacamole, and salsa for assembly into wraps with a smoky, savory taste.
desc.Panna cotta: Panna cotta is an Italian dessert made by thickening sweetened cream with gelatin and molding it, often flavored with vanilla or coffee. It is served chilled with a smooth, creamy, and delicate texture that melts in the mouth.
desc.Falafel: Falafel consists of deep-fried balls or patties made from ground chickpeas or fava beans mixed with herbs and spices. It is typically served in a pita or flatbread with salads, pickled vegetables, and tahini sauce, offering a crispy exterior, tender interior, and earthy, herby flavor.
desc.Palak paneer: Palak paneer is an Indian dish of paneer cheese cubes in a thick purée made from spinach. It is simmered with spices and served hot as a creamy, mildly spiced vegetarian curry with a smooth texture.
desc.Babaocai: Eight Treasures Stir-fry is a Chinese dish made by stir-frying a combination of eight ingredients including various vegetables, seafood like shrimp and squid, meat, tofu, or leftovers. It is seasoned with soy sauce and sesame oil, then served hot with a savory, umami-rich taste and varied textures.
desc.Pad see ew: Pad see ew is a Thai stir-fried noodle dish made with wide rice noodles, Chinese broccoli, egg, and protein such as chicken or beef in a sweet-savory soy-based sauce. It is cooked quickly in a wok and served hot with a slightly smoky, chewy texture.
desc.Pad thai: Pad Thai is a Thai stir-fried rice noodle dish typically made with shrimp, peanuts, green onions, scrambled egg, sugar, and bean sprouts in a tangy-sweet sauce. The ingredients are fried together in a wok and served hot with a balance of sweet, sour, and savory flavors.
desc.Flat white: A flat white is a coffee drink made with espresso and steamed milk, featuring a higher proportion of espresso to milk than a latte and a smooth, velvety texture without a thick foam layer like a cappuccino. It is typically served hot in a small cup, offering a balanced, rich coffee flavor with creamy milk notes.
desc.Pizza: Pizza is an Italian dish consisting of a flat, round base of leavened wheat dough topped with tomato sauce, cheese, and various other ingredients, then baked at high temperature until the crust is crisp and the toppings are melted and bubbly. It is often sliced and served hot, tasting savory, cheesy, and tangy from the tomato and herbs.
desc.Pico de gallo: Pico de gallo is a fresh Mexican salsa made from chopped tomatoes, onions, serrano or jalapeño peppers, cilantro, lime juice, and salt, mixed together without cooking. It is served as a topping or dip, providing a crisp, juicy texture with bright, spicy, and tangy flavors.
desc.Pita: Pita is a round, yeast-leavened flatbread made from wheat flour that is baked until it puffs up, creating an interior pocket. It is commonly served warm, either plain or stuffed with fillings, and has a soft, chewy texture with a mild, slightly wheaty taste.
desc.Har gow: Har gow is a Cantonese dumpling filled with shrimp meat and other seasonings, wrapped in a thin, translucent flour dough and steamed until the wrapper becomes clear and the filling is cooked. It is served hot as part of dim sum, with a delicate, slightly sweet shrimp flavor and soft, chewy texture.
desc.Hawaiian pizza: Hawaiian pizza is a pizza topped with tomato sauce, mozzarella cheese, pineapple chunks, and ham or bacon. It is baked until the crust is golden and the toppings are bubbly, resulting in a sweet-savory taste combining the fruity pineapple with salty, cheesy elements.
desc.Highball: A highball is a mixed drink consisting of a base spirit like whiskey combined with a carbonated mixer such as soda water or ginger ale, served over ice in a tall glass. It is refreshing and effervescent, with the mixer's bubbles lightening the spirit's flavor for a crisp, balanced taste.
desc.Hot dog: A hot dog is a sausage, typically a frankfurter or wiener, that is grilled, steamed, or boiled and served in a sliced bun. It is commonly topped with condiments like mustard, ketchup, onions, or relish, offering a savory, smoky sausage flavor with soft, warm bread and tangy or sweet accents from the toppings.
desc.Hamburger: A hamburger consists of a patty of ground beef that is panfried or grilled, placed inside a sliced bun along with toppings such as lettuce, tomato, onion, pickles, and condiments like ketchup, mustard, or mayonnaise. It is served hot, delivering a juicy, savory meat taste balanced by fresh, crisp vegetables and tangy sauces.
desc.Rye bread: Rye bread is a dense loaf made primarily from rye flour, which can range from light to dark in color. It is baked and sliced for serving, with a strong, earthy flavor and chewy texture that is more robust than wheat bread.
desc.Black tea: Black tea is a beverage made from oxidized leaves of the Camellia sinensis plant, steeped in hot water. It is served hot or iced, often plain or with milk and sugar, and has a bold, robust flavor that is stronger and more astringent than other teas.
desc.Hoe: Hoe is a Korean dish of thinly sliced raw fish or meat, often served with dipping sauces or wrapped in greens. It is eaten fresh, providing a tender, clean taste with subtle sweetness from the seafood or mild richness from the meat.
desc.Omelette: An omelette is a dish made by beating eggs and cooking them in a frying pan with butter or oil until set. It is often filled or topped with ingredients such as cheese, vegetables, mushrooms, or meats like ham or bacon, resulting in a fluffy, tender texture with savory flavors.
desc.Ssam: Ssam-bap consists of bite-sized portions where cooked rice, meat, and vegetables are wrapped in fresh leafy greens. It is typically served with a spicy fermented soybean paste called ssamjang, along with garlic or kimchi, delivering a fresh, crunchy contrast to the savory fillings.
desc.Salisbury steak: Hamburger steak, also known as Salisbury steak, is a patty made from ground beef mixed with other ingredients like breadcrumbs or onions. It is pan-fried or broiled and commonly served with a brown gravy, offering a juicy, savory taste similar to a hamburger without the bun.
desc.Gözleme: Gözleme is a Turkish stuffed turnover made from thin unleavened dough that is filled with ingredients such as spinach, cheese, minced meat, or vegetables. It is sealed and cooked on a griddle until golden and crispy, resulting in a savory, flaky pastry with a warm, flavorful filling.
desc.French onion soup: French onion soup is a savory soup made by slowly sautéing onions and simmering them in meat stock or water. It is typically served hot in a bowl with croutons or bread topped with melted cheese, creating a rich, sweet onion flavor with a brothy base.
desc.Caffè americano: An iced Americano is a coffee drink made by combining espresso shots with cold water and ice. It offers a lighter, less intense version of espresso with a smooth, slightly bitter taste that retains the coffee's complex flavors.
desc.Standing rib roast: Prime rib is a large cut of beef from the rib primal, roasted standing upright on its bones until the exterior is browned and the interior is juicy and tender, often served sliced in restaurants with au jus or horseradish sauce for a rich, savory beef flavor.
desc.Hummus: Hummus is a creamy dip made from blended cooked chickpeas, tahini, lemon juice, and garlic, typically garnished with olive oil, paprika, and whole chickpeas, served cold or at room temperature in cafés with pita bread for scooping its smooth, nutty, and tangy taste.
desc.Cheese sandwich: A cheese sandwich consists of slices of semi-hard cheese like cheddar layered between buttered bread, sometimes grilled to melt the cheese into a gooey, savory filling with a crispy exterior, commonly served as a simple café lunch item.
desc.Pa amb tomàquet: Pan con tomate is a slice of bread rubbed with fresh tomato and drizzled with olive oil and salt, often toasted and sometimes topped with cured ham or cheese, served as a simple, juicy, and garlicky appetizer in Spanish restaurants.
desc.Focaccia: Focaccia is a thick, flat Italian bread baked in the oven with olive oil, often dimpled on top and sprinkled with herbs or salt, resulting in a chewy, airy texture with a crispy crust, commonly served warm in Italian restaurants as a starter or side.
desc.Dahi vada: Dahi vada is a chaat snack of fried lentil dumplings soaked in thick, spiced yogurt, often garnished with chutneys and spices, served chilled in Indian restaurants for its soft, spongy texture with a cool, tangy, and savory taste.
desc.Idli: Idli is a soft, spongy South Indian steamed rice cake made from a fermented batter of rice and black lentils, typically served hot in restaurants with sambar and chutneys for a mild, slightly sour flavor.
desc.Upma: Upma is a thick, savory porridge made by cooking dry-roasted semolina with water, vegetables, and seasonings like mustard seeds and curry leaves, stirred until fluffy and served hot in South Indian cafés as a mildly spiced breakfast dish.
desc.Masala dosa: Masala dosa is a thin, crispy fermented rice and lentil crepe filled with a spiced potato mixture, folded and served hot in Indian restaurants with sambar and coconut chutney for its crunchy texture and savory, aromatic taste.
