desc.Dosa: Paper dosa is an extra-thin, large, and crisp version of a South Indian fermented rice and lentil crepe, often served plain or rolled with chutneys and sambar in restaurants, offering a light, crunchy texture with a mild tangy flavor.
desc.Masala chai: Masala chai is a spiced tea beverage brewed with black tea, milk, sugar, and aromatic spices like ginger, cardamom, and cinnamon, simmered together and often served hot and frothy in Indian cafés for its sweet, warming, and fragrant taste.
desc.Lassi: Mango lassi is a smooth, creamy yogurt-based drink blended with mango pulp, water, and sometimes sugar or spices, served chilled in Indian restaurants as a refreshing, sweet-tart, and fruity beverage with a smoothie-like consistency.
desc.Chitranna: Lemon rice is a South Indian rice dish made by mixing cooked rice with a seasoning of mustard seeds, fried lentils, peanuts, curry leaves, chillies, and lemon juice, which gives it a bright yellow color from turmeric. It is typically served as a light meal or side, offering a tangy, spicy, and nutty flavor.
desc.Kottu: Kothu parotta is a South Indian dish of chopped parotta flatbread stir-fried with a meat curry such as chicken or beef, scrambled eggs, onions, and chillies. It is served hot, often as a street food, with a spicy, savory taste and a mix of crispy and soft textures.
desc.Raita: Raita is an Indian yogurt-based side dish or condiment made with dahi mixed with raw or cooked vegetables, fruit, or pulses, and seasoned with herbs and spices like cumin, mint, and cayenne. It is served alongside rice dishes or curries to provide a cool, creamy, and mildly tangy contrast to spicy flavors.
desc.Papadam: Papadum is a thin, crispy Indian snack made from dough of black gram bean flour or other legume flours, which is deep-fried or dry-cooked until crunchy. It is typically served as an accompaniment to meals or as an appetizer with dips like chutneys, offering a light, brittle texture and neutral or mildly spiced taste.
desc.Rasam: Rasam is a spicy, watery South Indian soup-like dish usually served as a side with rice. It is made with tamarind, tomatoes, and a distinctive seasoning of spices and herbs, resulting in a tangy, peppery, and aromatic flavor that is lighter than sambar.
desc.Avial: Aviyal is a thick South Indian vegetable stew made with a medley of vegetables and coconut, seasoned with coconut oil and curry leaves. It is served as a main dish in meals, with a creamy, mildly spiced taste and a variety of vegetable textures.
desc.Kheer: Payasam is a creamy Indian rice pudding made by boiling milk with rice, sugar or jaggery, and often flavored with dried fruits, nuts, cardamom, or saffron. It is served warm or chilled as a dessert, with a rich, sweet, and aromatic taste.
desc.Poriyal: Poriyal is a Tamil stir-fried or sautéed vegetable side dish made with shredded or diced vegetables, mustard seeds, lentils, spices, and often topped with shredded coconut. It is served alongside rice and curries, providing a lightly spiced, crunchy, and fresh vegetable flavor.
desc.Koottu: Kootu is a South Indian lentil and vegetable stew that is semi-solid in consistency, made with lentils, vegetables, coconut, and spices. It is typically served with rice as part of a meal, offering nutty, mildly spicy flavors and varied textures.
desc.Bonda (snack): Bonda is a deep-fried South Indian snack consisting of a spiced potato filling coated in a chickpea flour batter. It is served hot and crispy, with a savory, mildly spiced potato interior and crunchy exterior.
desc.Ice cream: Ice cream is a frozen dessert made from milk or cream sweetened and flavored with ingredients like sugar, cocoa, vanilla, or fruit, then churned while freezing to create a smooth, airy texture. It is typically served cold in scoops, cones, or bowls and has a creamy, sweet taste that melts in the mouth.
desc.Egg sandwich: An egg sandwich consists of bread filled with a cooked egg preparation such as fried eggs, scrambled eggs, sliced boiled eggs, or egg salad mixed with mayonnaise and mustard. It is assembled cold or warm and offers a creamy, savory flavor from the egg filling.
desc.Pannenkoek: Dutch pancake is a thin, large pancake made from a simple batter of flour, milk, eggs, and salt, sometimes incorporating fillings like bacon, apples, or cheese during cooking. It is pan-fried until golden, then served rolled or flat with toppings such as syrup, powdered sugar, or apple butter for a soft, mildly sweet or savory taste.
desc.Lasagna: Lasagna is an Italian baked pasta dish made with wide, flat sheets layered with fillings such as meat, vegetables, cheese, and sauce, then topped with grated cheese. It is oven-baked until bubbly and golden, resulting in a rich, hearty texture with savory, cheesy flavors.
desc.Ragù: Ragù is an Italian meat-based sauce typically made by slowly cooking meat with vegetables, tomatoes, and seasonings until it becomes tender and flavorful. It is commonly served over pasta for a rich, savory taste with tender chunks of meat in a thick sauce.
desc.Naengmyeon: Mul naengmyeon is a cold Korean noodle dish featuring thin, chewy buckwheat noodles served in a chilled, tangy broth made from beef or vegetable stock. It is typically topped with sliced meat, vegetables, and a boiled egg, offering a refreshing, savory, and slightly sour taste.
desc.Caulerpa lentillifera: Sea grapes are small, succulent green seaweed pearls that grow in clusters on thin stems. They are typically served raw in salads or as a side dish, often with a light dressing or soy-based sauce, and have a crisp, juicy texture with a mild salty, oceanic flavor.
desc.Mozuku: Mozuku is a type of Japanese brown seaweed with thin, slippery strands. It is usually served raw or lightly blanched in a vinegar-based dressing, offering a soft, gelatinous texture and a mild, slightly sweet oceanic taste.
desc.Potato salad: Potato salad is a cold side dish made from boiled and cubed potatoes mixed with a creamy dressing such as mayonnaise, often combined with chopped boiled eggs, onions, or other vegetables. It has a smooth, tangy flavor with varying degrees of creaminess depending on the recipe.
desc.Salumi: Salumi are Italian cured meat products, primarily made from pork, that are sliced thin and served uncooked as part of an antipasto platter. They include varieties like prosciutto and salami, offering rich, salty, and savory flavors with textures ranging from tender to firm.
desc.Skirt steak: Skirt steak is a long, flat cut of beef from the plate primal, known for its intense beefy flavor. It is typically grilled or seared quickly over high heat and sliced against the grain, resulting in a chewy yet juicy texture.
desc.Dr Pepper: Dr Pepper is a dark, carbonated soft drink with a unique blend of 23 fruit and spice flavors. It is served chilled, typically over ice, and has a sweet, bold taste that is neither cola nor root beer.
desc.General Tso's chicken: General Tso's chicken is a Chinese-American dish of deep-fried chicken pieces that are coated in a sweet, spicy, and tangy sauce typically made with soy sauce, garlic, ginger, sugar, and chili peppers. It is served hot, often with a crispy exterior and tender interior, delivering a bold balance of sweetness and heat.
desc.Hash browns: Hash browns are a breakfast dish made from finely julienned or shredded potatoes that are pan-fried or grilled until golden brown and crispy on the outside. They are often served as patties or loose shreds alongside eggs and other breakfast items, with a savory, potato-forward taste.
desc.Coleslaw: Coleslaw is a side dish consisting primarily of finely shredded raw cabbage mixed with a dressing such as mayonnaise or vinaigrette, sometimes including carrots or onions. It is served cold and offers a crisp, creamy or tangy texture with a refreshing crunch.
desc.Pepsi Zero Sugar: Pepsi Zero Sugar is a sugar-free cola soft drink that uses artificial sweeteners like aspartame and acesulfame potassium to mimic the taste of regular Pepsi. It is served chilled, providing a crisp, bubbly, and sweet cola flavor without calories from sugar.
desc.Carbonated water: Sparkling water is water that has been infused with carbon dioxide gas under pressure, creating effervescent bubbles. It is served chilled, either plain or with added minerals, and has a crisp, fizzy taste that feels refreshing and slightly tart on the palate.
desc.Iced tea: Iced tea is a chilled form of brewed tea, usually black tea, that may be sweetened with sugar or flavored with fruit syrups like lemon or peach. It is served over ice and offers a refreshing, mildly astringent taste that can range from unsweetened and brisk to sweet and fruity.
desc.Curly fries: Curly fries are french fries cut into a spiral or twisted shape, then deep-fried until crispy and golden. They are often seasoned with spices and served as a side dish, delivering a crunchy texture with a savory, potato-based flavor enhanced by the curly form that holds seasonings well.
desc.Rafute: Rafute is a dish of skin-on pork belly stewed until tender in a mixture of soy sauce and brown sugar. It is served hot, resulting in rich, savory-sweet meat with a melt-in-the-mouth texture from the slow cooking process.
desc.Okinawa soba: Okinawa soba is a noodle dish featuring thick wheat noodles served in a savory broth similar to ramen, often topped with pork or other ingredients. The noodles have a chewy texture and are typically enjoyed hot, with a comforting, umami-rich taste from the soup.
desc.Kakiage: Vegetable fritter, known as kakiage, is a Japanese tempura dish made by batter-dipping and deep-frying a mix of shredded vegetables or small seafood pieces, resulting in a light, crispy texture with a savory taste.
desc.Chicken katsu: Chicken cutlet, or chicken katsu, is a Japanese dish of chicken coated in panko breadcrumbs and deep-fried to a crispy golden brown, offering a juicy interior and crunchy exterior, often served with a tangy sauce.
desc.Kimchi fried rice: Kimchi fried rice is a Korean dish made by stir-frying rice with chopped kimchi and other ingredients like vegetables or meats, delivering a spicy, tangy, and savory flavor with a satisfying texture.
desc.Yuja tea: Yuzu tea is a hot beverage made by mixing yuja-cheong, a sweet thick pulpy syrup or marmalade from the yuzu fruit, with hot water. It has a fragrant citrus taste that is both tart and sweet, contains no caffeine, and is often enjoyed as a soothing winter drink.
desc.Strawberry ice cream: Strawberry ice cream is a pink or light red frozen dessert made by blending fresh strawberries or strawberry flavoring into a base of eggs, cream, vanilla, and sugar. It has a creamy sweet-tart berry taste and is one of the classic flavors found in Neapolitan ice cream.
desc.Latte macchiato: Caramel macchiato is an espresso-based drink made by pouring a shot of espresso into steamed milk, creating a layered effect where the coffee stains the milk. It is often sweetened with vanilla syrup and topped with caramel drizzle for a smooth, milky coffee taste with sweet caramel notes.
desc.Cold brew coffee: Cold brew is a smooth coffee concentrate made by steeping coarse coffee grounds in cool water for 12 to 24 hours, then filtering. It is typically diluted with water or milk and served chilled over ice, resulting in a less acidic, mellow coffee flavor.
desc.Pie: Pie is a baked dish consisting of a pastry dough casing filled with sweet or savory ingredients such as fruit, nuts, custard, meat, or vegetables. It is served in slices with a flaky crust and flavorful filling that can range from sweet to hearty depending on the ingredients.
desc.Hibiscus tea: Hibiscus tea is a tart infusion made by steeping the crimson calyces of the hibiscus flower in hot water. It has a strong, cranberry-like flavor that is tangy and refreshing whether served hot or cold.
desc.List of lemon-lime drink brands: Lemon-lime soda is a carbonated soft drink flavored with lemon and lime, typically served chilled in glasses over ice in restaurants and cafes as a refreshing beverage.
desc.Meat chop: Lamb chops are individual portions of lamb meat cut perpendicular to the spine, often including a rib bone; they are typically grilled, pan-fried, or broiled and served hot as a main course in restaurants.
desc.Beef tenderloin: Beef tenderloin is a tender cut of beef from the loin, usually prepared by roasting, grilling, or pan-searing; it is served sliced as a premium steak or in dishes like beef Wellington in upscale restaurants.
desc.Dakos: Dakos is a Cretan salad consisting of a slice of soaked barley bread topped with chopped tomatoes, feta or mizithra cheese, olives, capers, and oregano; it is assembled and served cold as a light dish in cafes and restaurants.
desc.Coca-Cola Zero Sugar: Coca-Cola Zero is a no-calorie diet cola soft drink sweetened with artificial sweeteners to mimic the taste of regular Coca-Cola; it is served chilled, often over ice, in restaurants and cafes.
desc.Fanta: Fanta is a carbonated soft drink with fruit flavors, most commonly orange; it is served chilled in glasses or bottles in restaurants and cafes as a sweet, fizzy beverage.
desc.Ayran: Ayran is a cold, savory yogurt-based drink made by mixing yogurt with water and salt, sometimes with added herbs like mint; it is served chilled as a refreshing beverage in restaurants.
desc.Red Bull: Red Bull is an energy drink containing caffeine, taurine, and B vitamins; it is served chilled in cans or mixed into cocktails in cafes, bars, and restaurants.
desc.Stella Artois: Stella Artois is a pilsner beer with a crisp, clean taste; it is served chilled in glasses, often as a draught, in restaurants, cafes, and bars.
desc.Tea: Tea is an aromatic beverage prepared by steeping the leaves of the Camellia sinensis plant in hot water. It is typically served hot or iced, often plain or with additions like milk, sugar, or lemon, and has a flavor ranging from slightly bitter and astringent to sweet, nutty, floral, or grassy depending on the variety.
desc.Flatbread: Flatbread is a thin, flattened bread made from a simple dough of flour, water, and salt that is rolled out and baked quickly at high heat. It is commonly served as a staple alongside meals or used to wrap fillings, with a soft to crisp texture depending on preparation.
desc.Fish steak: Salmon steak is a thick cross-section cut of salmon perpendicular to the spine, typically including the bone and skin, that is grilled, pan-seared, or baked. It has a rich, flaky texture and mild, buttery flavor often enhanced with simple seasonings like salt, pepper, and lemon.
desc.Cooked rice: Steamed rice consists of rice grains cooked by steaming or boiling until tender and fluffy. It is served hot as a neutral base for various dishes, absorbing flavors from accompanying sauces or ingredients while offering a soft, slightly sticky texture.
desc.Lemon sour: Lemon sour is a carbonated lemon-flavored soda used as a mixer in cocktails or enjoyed on its own. It has a tart, sweet, and fizzy taste, often served chilled in glasses with or without alcohol.
desc.Panzanella: Panzanella is an Italian chopped salad made with soaked stale bread, tomatoes, onions, and often cucumbers, dressed with olive oil and vinegar. It is served at room temperature with a juicy, tangy flavor and soft yet textured bread pieces.
desc.Cacciatore: Chicken cacciatore is a rustic Italian dish of chicken pieces braised with onions, herbs, tomatoes, and often bell peppers or mushrooms, sometimes finished with red or white wine. It is typically served hot as a hearty main course with a rich, savory tomato-based sauce.
desc.Greek salad: Greek salad, also known as horiatiki, consists of chunks of fresh tomatoes, cucumbers, red onion, feta cheese, and Kalamata olives, simply dressed with olive oil, oregano, and salt. It is served cold or at room temperature as a refreshing, crisp, and tangy starter or side.
desc.Chef salad: Chef's salad is an American composed salad featuring a bed of lettuce topped with hard-boiled eggs, slices of ham, turkey or roast beef, tomatoes, cucumbers, and cheese, often accompanied by a choice of dressing. It is served cold as a substantial main course with a variety of fresh, savory flavors.
desc.Spinach salad: Spinach salad centers on fresh spinach leaves, commonly dressed in the classic American style with a hot bacon vinaigrette that lightly wilts the greens, and may include toppings like eggs, mushrooms, or onions. It is served warm or at room temperature with a smoky, tangy taste.
desc.Pastitsio: Pastitsio is a Greek baked pasta casserole layered with tubular pasta, ground meat in a tomato sauce, and a thick béchamel sauce on top. It is served hot in slices with a creamy, savory, and comforting taste.
desc.Pork chop: A pork chop is a thick cut of meat from the pig, typically including a rib bone, that is fried, grilled, or baked plain or breaded, and often paired with vegetables or sauces. It is served hot with a juicy, savory flavor depending on the seasoning and cooking method.
desc.Squid as food: Calamari refers to squid prepared as food, most commonly cut into rings, battered, and deep-fried until golden and tender. It is served hot as an appetizer with a mild, slightly sweet seafood taste and crispy texture, often accompanied by dipping sauces.
desc.Eggplant salads and appetizers: Melitzanosalata is a Greek eggplant salad or dip made from roasted or grilled eggplant that is mashed and mixed with olive oil, garlic, and seasonings. It is served cold or at room temperature as a creamy, smoky, and garlicky spread or side.
desc.Skordalia: Skordalia is a thick Greek purée made by blending garlic with a base of potatoes, nuts, or soaked bread and olive oil to form a smooth emulsion, with vinegar added for brightness. It is served as a dip or side with a strong, pungent garlic flavor and creamy texture.
desc.Saganaki: Saganaki is a Greek appetizer consisting of firm cheese fried in a small pan until golden and often flambéed with brandy tableside. It is served hot with a salty, melty interior and crispy exterior, typically drizzled with lemon juice.
desc.Stuffed peppers: Stuffed peppers consist of hollowed or halved bell peppers filled with a mixture often including meat, vegetables, cheese, rice, or sauce. They are assembled by filling the pepper cavities and then baked or cooked until tender, resulting in a savory and hearty dish.
desc.Fruitcake: Fruitcake is a dense cake made with candied or dried fruit, nuts, and spices, sometimes soaked in spirits. It is rich and sweet, often served sliced on its own without additional condiments.
desc.Galaktoboureko: Galaktoboureko is a dessert made with layers of filo dough filled with semolina custard and covered in syrup. It is baked until golden and crisp, offering a sweet, creamy texture with a syrupy finish.
desc.White wine: White wine is a fermented beverage produced from the juice of grapes without skin contact, resulting in colors from straw-yellow to gold. It is served chilled and ranges from dry and crisp to sweet and fruity depending on the grape variety and winemaking method.
desc.Red wine: Red wine is made from dark-colored grapes with skin contact during fermentation to extract color and flavor. It ranges from intense violet in young wines to brick red or brown in mature ones, typically served at room temperature with bold, tannic, or fruity notes.
desc.Juice: Juice is a beverage extracted by pressing the liquid from fruits or vegetables. It is served cold, either pure or blended, and offers fresh, naturally sweet flavors depending on the produce used.
desc.Squash: Cordial, also known as squash, is a sweet, concentrated fruit-flavored syrup mixed with water to make a non-alcoholic drink. It is diluted to taste, served chilled, and provides a refreshing, fruity flavor.
desc.Milkshake: A milkshake is a thick, sweet, cold beverage made by blending milk, ice cream, and flavorings such as chocolate, fruit, or caramel. It is served in a glass with a straw and has a creamy, rich taste.
desc.Orange juice: Orange juice is a beverage extracted by squeezing or reaming fresh oranges. It is served chilled, with or without pulp, and has a sweet-tart, citrus flavor.
desc.Pineapple juice: Pineapple juice is extracted from the pulp of pineapples and is typically canned or served chilled. It has a sweet, tangy tropical flavor and can be enjoyed pure or in mixed drinks.
desc.Loco moco: Loco moco is a dish of white rice topped with a hamburger patty, brown gravy, and a sunny-side-up fried egg. It is served hot and combines savory, meaty flavors with the richness of egg and gravy.
desc.Mango pudding: Mango pudding is a creamy dessert made with agar or gelatin, fresh mangoes, evaporated milk, and sugar, often garnished with additional fresh fruit like mango or berries. It is served chilled and has a rich, smooth, and fruity taste with a delicate, jiggly texture.
desc.Club soda: Club soda is a carbonated water beverage with added minerals such as sodium bicarbonate or potassium sulfate to enhance flavor and balance acidity. It is commonly served cold as a standalone drink or mixer and has a crisp, effervescent, and slightly salty taste.
desc.Guacamole: Guacamole is an avocado-based dip or spread made by mashing ripe avocados with ingredients such as lime juice, onions, tomatoes, cilantro, and salt. It is typically served fresh at room temperature or chilled as a dip with tortilla chips and has a creamy, tangy, and mildly spicy taste.
desc.Dolma: Dolma consists of vegetables or leaves, such as grape leaves or bell peppers, that are stuffed with a filling of rice, minced meat, herbs, and spices before being rolled or baked. It is often served warm or at room temperature as an appetizer and has a savory, herby, and slightly tangy flavor.
desc.Crostini: Crostini are small slices of grilled or toasted bread topped with a variety of ingredients such as cheeses, meats, vegetables, olive oil, or herbs. They are served as an appetizer, often at room temperature, and have a crunchy texture with savory or fresh toppings.
desc.Fattoush: Fattoush is a Levantine salad made from toasted or fried pieces of pita bread combined with mixed greens and vegetables such as radishes, cucumbers, and tomatoes. It is typically served fresh as a light and crunchy part of meals in restaurants and cafés.
desc.Maqluba: Maqluba is a Levantine pilaf dish consisting of meat, rice, and fried vegetables layered in a pot and flipped upside down when served, creating an inverted presentation. It is commonly offered in Middle Eastern restaurants as a hearty, savory main course with tender ingredients and spiced flavors.
desc.Lalab: Lalapan is a Sundanese raw vegetable salad from Indonesia, featuring an assortment of fresh or blanched vegetables like cucumber, tomato, cabbage, and long beans. It is served with a spicy sambal terasi dipping sauce as a crisp, refreshing side dish in restaurants and cafés.
desc.Fruit salad: Fruit salad is a dish made from various kinds of chopped fresh fruit, sometimes served in their natural juices or a light syrup. It is commonly offered as a sweet, juicy appetizer, side, or dessert in restaurants and cafés, ranging from simple to more elaborate versions with added ingredients.
desc.Korokke: Potato croquette, known as korokke in Japan, is a deep-fried dish made by mixing mashed potato with chopped meat, seafood, or vegetables, then shaping into patties, breading, and frying until golden brown. It is served crispy on the outside with a soft, savory interior in Japanese and fusion restaurants.
desc.Tamagoyaki: Tamagoyaki is a Japanese omelette made by repeatedly rolling and cooking layers of sweetened, seasoned beaten eggs in a rectangular pan. It has a slightly sweet, fluffy texture and is often served sliced as a side or in bento boxes at Japanese restaurants and cafés.
desc.Spam musubi: Spam musubi is a Hawaiian snack consisting of a slice of grilled Spam placed on a block of rice and wrapped with nori seaweed. It is portable, savory, and salty, commonly served in Hawaiian restaurants, convenience stores, and cafés.
desc.Clam chowder: Clam chowder is a creamy soup featuring clams as the star ingredient along with diced potatoes, onions, and often salt pork. It is typically served hot in a bowl, sometimes accompanied by crackers, and has a rich, savory taste with a velvety texture from the milk or cream base.
desc.Cheese on toast: Cheese on toast, also known as cheese toast, consists of sliced or grated cheese placed on toasted bread and melted under a grill. It is a simple, hot open-faced dish with a crispy bread base and gooey, savory melted cheese on top.
desc.Strained yogurt: Greek yogurt is strained yogurt that has had most of its whey removed, resulting in a thick, creamy texture while retaining a tangy, sour taste. It is commonly made from cow's milk and served plain or with toppings in restaurants and cafes.
desc.Egg tart: Egg tart is a small pastry with a flaky crust filled with a smooth egg custard. It is baked until the custard is set and is commonly served warm or at room temperature in dim sum restaurants and cafes, offering a sweet, creamy egg flavor.
desc.Vanilla ice cream: Vanilla ice cream is a frozen dessert flavored with vanilla beans, extract, or vanillin. It is churned with cream, milk, and sugar to create a smooth, sweet, and creamy treat that is often considered the classic or default ice cream flavor.
desc.Bánh mì: Banh mi is a Vietnamese sandwich served on a short, crusty baguette roll that is split and filled with meats such as pork or sausage, along with pickled vegetables, cucumber, herbs, and condiments like mayonnaise and chili. It combines crispy bread with savory, fresh, and tangy flavors.
desc.Cheesesteak: Philly cheesesteak is a sandwich made with thinly sliced beefsteak and melted cheese stuffed into a long hoagie roll. It is typically served hot and gooey, with a savory, beefy taste enhanced by the melted cheese.
desc.Cuban sandwich: Cuban sandwich is a pressed sandwich made with ham, roast pork, Swiss cheese, pickles, and mustard on Cuban bread. It is served hot and crispy, delivering a savory, tangy, and melty combination of flavors.
desc.Tabbouleh: Tabbouleh is a salad of finely chopped parsley, tomatoes, mint, onion, and soaked bulgur, dressed with olive oil, lemon juice, and seasonings. It is served cold or at room temperature as part of a mezze, with a fresh, bright, and herbaceous taste.
desc.Stew: Beef stew is a hearty dish of cubed beef and vegetables simmered slowly in liquid such as stock or wine until tender, forming a thick gravy. It is often served hot in bowls or over starches and tastes rich, savory, and deeply flavored from the slow melding of ingredients.
desc.Fried egg: A fried egg is an egg removed from its shell and cooked in a frying pan, often sunny-side up, over-easy, or over-hard. It is commonly served for breakfast or brunch with sides like toast or bacon and has a creamy or runny yolk with a savory, slightly crispy edge.
desc.Sausage: Sausage is ground meat, often pork, beef, or poultry, mixed with salt, spices, and fillers, then formed into patties or stuffed into casings. It is typically pan-fried, broiled, or barbecued and served as a savory, spiced item with a juicy or crispy texture depending on preparation.
desc.Pork cutlet: Pork cutlet refers to breaded and fried pork slices, as in Japanese tonkatsu, Korean dongaseu, or Polish kotlet schabowy. It is typically served with sauces, vegetables, or starches and offers a crispy coating around tender, savory meat.
desc.Naan: Naan is a soft, leavened flatbread baked in an oven or tandoor, often brushed with ghee or yogurt. It has a fluffy texture with golden spots, a slightly chewy bite, and is served warm alongside curries or dips for its mild, wheaty flavor.
desc.Chicken tikka: Chicken tikka consists of chicken pieces marinated in yogurt and spices, then grilled or baked in a tandoor oven. It is served hot as a starter or main with accompaniments and has a tender, juicy texture with smoky, spiced, and tangy flavors.
desc.Shish kebab: Shish kebab is cubes of meat, often lamb, marinated and skewered then grilled over high heat. It is commonly served in restaurants with vegetables, rice, or bread and offers a smoky, charred exterior with juicy, seasoned interior meat.
desc.Chicken salad: Chicken salad is a mixture of chopped cooked chicken combined with mayonnaise, celery, onion, and seasonings like mustard or pickles. It is typically served cold in sandwiches, on greens, or as a side and has a creamy, savory taste with crisp and tangy elements.
desc.Kouign-amann: Kouign-amann is a round, laminated Breton pastry made with layered buttery dough and sugar that caramelizes during slow baking. It is served warm or at room temperature in cafés and has a flaky, crisp exterior with a soft, buttery, sweet interior.
desc.Fried cauliflower: Fried cauliflower is a dish where cauliflower florets are dipped in batter or breading and then fried in oil or butter until crispy. It is often served hot as an appetizer, side dish, or in sandwiches, seasoned with salt, spices, and sauces like tahini or yogurt, offering a savory, crunchy texture with a mild cauliflower flavor.
desc.Fried cheese: Fried cheese is a dish made by coating or dipping cheese in batter or breading and then pan-frying or deep-frying it until golden and melty. It is typically served hot as an appetizer or snack, sometimes with a dipping sauce, providing a crispy exterior and gooey, savory interior.
desc.Meatball: Meatballs are ground meat mixed with ingredients like breadcrumbs, onion, eggs, and seasonings, then rolled into balls and cooked by frying, baking, steaming, or in sauce. They come in many varieties with different meats and spices, offering a savory, tender, and flavorful bite.
desc.Margarita: A margarita is a cocktail made with tequila, triple sec, and lime juice, sometimes with simple syrup. It is served shaken with ice, straight up, or frozen, often in a margarita glass with a salted or Tajín rim, delivering a tart, sweet, and refreshing taste.
desc.Moscow mule: A Moscow mule is a cocktail combining vodka, ginger beer, and lime juice, garnished with a lime wedge. It is traditionally served in a copper mug, resulting in a spicy, tangy, and refreshing drink with a fizzy texture.
desc.Fizz (cocktail): A gin fizz is a cocktail from the sours family, featuring gin, lemon or lime juice, sugar, and carbonated water. It is shaken and served in a tall glass, offering a light, effervescent, tart, and slightly sweet flavor.
desc.Meringue: Meringue is a dessert made from whipped egg whites and sugar, sometimes with an acidic ingredient like lemon or cream of tartar. It is baked to form light, airy, and sweet confections that can be chewy inside with a crisp exterior or fully crisp.
desc.Soup: Soup is a liquid dish made by combining meat, vegetables, or other ingredients with stock, milk, or water, then cooked to vary in consistency from thin and delicate to thick and hearty. It is generally served warm or hot, and can be savory or sweet, with flavors ranging from light to rich.
desc.Fish and chips: Fish and chips is battered and deep-fried fish served hot alongside fried potato chips. The dish features crispy, golden batter on flaky fish paired with salty, crunchy fries for a satisfying savory taste.
desc.Lemonade: Strawberry lemonade is a sweetened drink made with lemon juice, water, sugar, and strawberry flavoring or puree. It can be still or carbonated, served chilled, and tastes tart, sweet, and fruity.
desc.Yukhoe: Yukhoe is a dish of thinly sliced raw beef marinated in a savory sauce. It is typically served chilled or at room temperature, offering a tender, fresh texture with umami and slightly sweet flavors.
desc.Miso soup: Miso soup is a Japanese broth made by dissolving miso paste in dashi stock, often including ingredients like tofu, wakame seaweed, and green onions. It is served hot as a savory, umami-rich accompaniment to meals.
desc.Ponzu: Ponzu sauce is a thin, tart Japanese citrus-based sauce made from ingredients like soy sauce, rice vinegar, and dashi. It is commonly used as a dipping sauce or dressing, providing a bright, salty, and tangy flavor.
desc.Tsukemono: Tsukemono are Japanese pickled vegetables preserved in salt, brine, or rice bran. They are served as a crisp, tangy side dish or garnish alongside rice or meals.
desc.Eruca sativa: Rocket salad features the peppery, slightly bitter leaves of arugula as its main ingredient, often mixed with other greens or simple dressings. It is served fresh and raw, providing a sharp, crisp flavor.
desc.İmam bayıldı: Imam bayildi is a dish of whole eggplant stuffed with a mixture of onions, garlic, and tomatoes, then simmered in olive oil. It is served warm or at room temperature, with a soft, savory, and rich taste.
desc.Mandu-guk: Manduguk is a Korean dumpling soup made by boiling mandu dumplings in a clear beef or anchovy broth, often finished with beaten egg that is stirred in to create silky strands. It has a savory, comforting broth flavor with tender dumplings filled typically with meat and vegetables.
desc.Sukhoe: Octopus sukhoe is a Korean dish of briefly blanched octopus served cold as a type of hoe, typically accompanied by a dipping sauce of gochujang mixed with vinegar. The octopus has a tender, slightly chewy texture and mild seafood taste that pairs with the sweet-spicy and tangy sauce.
desc.Oyster omelette: Oyster omelette is a savory pancake-like dish made by frying oysters in a thin batter of starch, eggs, and sometimes rice flour until crispy on the outside. It features plump, briny oysters encased in a soft, eggy interior with a crispy exterior, often served with a sweet chili sauce.
desc.List of salads: Seafood salad is a mixed dish combining cooked or raw seafood such as shrimp, crab, or squid with vegetables, herbs, and a dressing that can be creamy, vinaigrette-style, or spicy. It is served cold and offers a refreshing blend of briny seafood flavors with crisp textures and bright acidity or creaminess depending on the preparation.
desc.White chocolate: White chocolate is a sweet confection made from cocoa butter, sugar, and milk solids, resulting in an ivory-colored treat without cocoa solids. It has a creamy, smooth texture and a rich, milky vanilla-like sweetness, often used in desserts or eaten as a bar.
desc.Soft drink: Soda, or soft drink, is a sweetened, flavored, and usually carbonated non-alcoholic beverage made with water, sugar or sweeteners, natural or artificial flavors, and sometimes caffeine or acids. It is served chilled, often over ice, and has a fizzy, sweet taste that can range from fruity to citrusy or cola-like.
desc.Fettuccine Alfredo: Chicken alfredo is a creamy pasta dish featuring pieces of tender chicken served with fettuccine coated in a rich sauce made from butter, heavy cream, and Parmesan cheese. The sauce is smooth and cheesy with a mild garlic flavor, creating a comforting, indulgent taste.
desc.Edamame: Edamame are young green soybeans still in their pods that are boiled or steamed until tender, then lightly salted or seasoned. They have a bright green color, firm yet yielding texture, and a fresh, nutty, slightly sweet flavor often enjoyed as a snack or side.
desc.Ribollita: Ribollita is a Tuscan bread soup made with stale bread, cannellini beans, lacinato kale, cabbage, and vegetables such as carrot, chard, celery, potatoes, and onion. It is prepared by simmering the ingredients together, often baked in a clay pot, resulting in a hearty, thick, and savory dish with soft textures from the bread and beans.
desc.Parmigiana: Eggplant Parmigiana is an Italian baked dish of fried, sliced eggplant layered with mozzarella cheese and tomato sauce. It is assembled in alternating layers and baked until bubbly, offering a rich, savory taste with crispy edges, creamy cheese, and tangy tomato.
desc.Pici: Pici is a thick, hand-rolled Tuscan pasta resembling fat spaghetti. It is made from a simple dough of flour and water, rolled into long strands, and typically served with a sauce, providing a chewy texture and mild wheat flavor.
desc.Bistecca alla fiorentina: Bistecca alla Fiorentina is a thick, bone-in loin steak from young beef, grilled over high heat until rare. It is served simply, often with a drizzle of olive oil, delivering a tender, juicy texture with a robust, beefy taste and charred exterior.
desc.T-bone steak: Bistecca is a T-bone steak cut from the short loin of beef, including sections of tenderloin and strip steak separated by a T-shaped bone. It is typically grilled and served as a hearty, flavorful cut with varying degrees of tenderness and rich, beefy taste.
desc.Prosciutto: Prosciutto crudo is an uncooked, unsmoked, dry-cured ham that is aged and served thinly sliced. It has a delicate, salty-sweet flavor with a tender, melt-in-the-mouth texture, often enjoyed as an appetizer or in sandwiches.
desc.Hamburg steak: Hambagu steak is a Japanese-style ground beef patty, often mixed with onions and seasonings then pan-fried. It is typically served with a savory sauce such as demi-glace, resulting in a juicy, tender texture with rich, umami beef flavor.
desc.Tonkotsu ramen: Tonkotsu ramen is a Japanese noodle dish featuring a cloudy, creamy broth made by boiling pork bones for many hours. It is served with wheat noodles and toppings like sliced pork belly, offering a rich, savory, and deeply pork-flavored soup.
desc.Shabu-shabu: Shabu-shabu is a Japanese hotpot dish of thinly sliced meat and vegetables that diners cook piece by piece in simmering water at the table. It is served with dipping sauces, resulting in a light, savory flavor with tender textures from quick cooking.
desc.Crab cake: A crab cake is a savory patty made primarily from crab meat mixed with breadcrumbs, mayonnaise, mustard, eggs, and seasonings, then sautéed, baked, grilled, or fried until golden and crisp on the outside. It has a tender, sweet crab flavor with a lightly seasoned, moist interior.
desc.Oysters Rockefeller: Oysters Rockefeller consist of oysters on the half-shell topped with a rich sauce of butter, parsley, other green herbs, and breadcrumbs, then baked or broiled until bubbly. They are served hot with lemon wedges and offer a savory, herbaceous, briny taste with a crisp topping.
desc.Waldorf salad: Waldorf salad is a crisp, refreshing mix of chopped celery, fresh apples, walnuts, and grapes coated in a creamy mayonnaise dressing, traditionally served on a bed of lettuce. It combines sweet, tart, and nutty flavors with a crunchy texture.
desc.Filet mignon: Filet mignon is a tender, lean, round cut of beef from the smaller end of the tenderloin, typically grilled, pan-seared, or broiled and often served simply with minimal seasoning. It has a mild, buttery flavor and a soft, melt-in-the-mouth texture.
desc.Steak au poivre: Steak au poivre is a seared steak, often filet mignon, coated in coarsely cracked peppercorns that form a pungent crust during cooking, frequently finished with a creamy pan sauce. It delivers bold, peppery heat balanced by the rich, savory beef.
desc.Surf and turf: Surf and turf is a main course pairing seafood such as lobster, shrimp, or scallops with red meat like beefsteak, often grilled or broiled and served together on one plate. It combines the sweet, delicate flavors of the sea with the hearty, juicy taste of the beef.
desc.Beef Wellington: Beef Wellington is a luxurious dish of beef fillet coated in duxelles or pâté, sometimes wrapped in prosciutto, then encased in puff pastry and baked until the pastry is golden and the beef is perfectly cooked. It is sliced to reveal a tender center with earthy, savory layers and a flaky, buttery crust.
desc.Creamed spinach: Creamed spinach is a side dish made by cooking spinach leaves and coating them in a smooth, rich sauce typically prepared from butter, cream, milk, and a touch of flour or cheese for thickening. It is often seasoned simply with salt, pepper, and nutmeg, resulting in a velvety texture and mild, earthy flavor with creamy richness.
desc.Bananas Foster: Bananas Foster is a dessert featuring bananas sautéed in a sauce of butter, brown sugar, cinnamon, dark rum, and banana liqueur, which is then flambéed to create a warm, caramelized syrup. It is typically served warm over scoops of vanilla ice cream, sometimes with added whipped cream or nuts, delivering a sweet, buttery taste with hints of rum and spice.
desc.Daiquiri: A daiquiri is a classic cocktail made by shaking or blending rum, fresh lime juice, and sugar or simple syrup until chilled and balanced. It is served strained into a chilled glass, often straight up, offering a crisp, tart, and refreshing taste with the sweetness of the rum coming through clearly.
desc.Marinara sauce: Marinara sauce is a simple tomato-based sauce prepared by simmering crushed or pureed tomatoes with garlic, onions, olive oil, and herbs such as basil and oregano. It is commonly served as a topping for pasta or used in dishes with meat or seafood, providing a bright, tangy flavor with savory herbal notes.
desc.Strawberry cake: Strawberry cake is a dessert featuring strawberries incorporated into the batter, layered on top, or mixed into the frosting of a soft sponge or butter cake. It is typically served chilled, resulting in a light, moist texture with sweet and slightly tart berry flavor throughout.
desc.Açai bowl: An açai bowl is a thick, blended smoothie made from frozen açai palm fruit puree, often sweetened with guaraná syrup or other additions, and served in a bowl topped with granola, sliced banana, and sometimes other fruits or nuts. It has a creamy yet slightly granular texture with an earthy, tart taste balanced by sweetness.
desc.Samgyeopsal: Samgyeopsal is a Korean grilled dish consisting of thick slices of pork belly, often with three distinct layers of meat and fat, that are cooked at the table on a grill until crispy and rendered. It is commonly served with accompanying vegetables, dipping sauces, and wraps, offering a rich, savory, and juicy flavor with smoky char.
desc.Kimchi-buchimgae: Kimchi jeon is a Korean savory pancake prepared by mixing chopped kimchi into a flour-based batter, often with added vegetables or ground pork, then pan-frying it until crispy and golden. It is typically served as a snack or appetizer, with a spicy, tangy flavor from the fermented kimchi balanced by the mild, chewy pancake.
desc.Jokbal: Jokbal is a Korean dish of pig's trotters braised slowly in a mixture of soy sauce, ginger, garlic, rice wine, and spices like cinnamon and black pepper until the meat is tender and infused with flavor. It is usually served sliced or shredded, often with a dipping sauce, providing a gelatinous yet tender texture and savory, aromatic taste.
desc.Xiaolongbao: Xiaolongbao is a Chinese steamed dumpling filled with pork and a savory broth. It is made by wrapping the filling in thin dough wrappers and steaming them in small bamboo baskets, served hot so the juicy soup bursts in the mouth with a tender, flavorful taste.
desc.Beef noodle soup: Beef noodle soup is a comforting noodle dish featuring tender stewed or braised beef in a savory broth with vegetables and noodles. It is typically served hot in a bowl, offering a rich, beefy flavor with balanced savory and aromatic notes from the broth.
desc.Taiwanese fried chicken cutlet: Taiwanese fried chicken is a crispy street food made from marinated chicken breast coated in sweet potato and rice flours, breaded with panko, and shallow-fried. It is seasoned with salt, five-spice powder, and white pepper, resulting in a crunchy exterior and juicy interior with savory, spiced taste.
desc.Wonton noodles: Wonton noodles consist of fresh egg noodles served in a hot broth with leafy greens like gai lan and filled wonton dumplings. The wontons are typically pork-based, and the dish is served steaming hot with a light, savory broth that highlights the delicate flavors.
desc.Sanbeiji: Sanbeiji is a braised chicken dish cooked with equal parts of soy sauce, rice wine, and sesame oil. It is prepared by stir-frying or simmering the chicken until tender, resulting in a savory, slightly sweet, and aromatic flavor with glossy sauce coating the meat.
desc.Wonton: Wontons are small Chinese dumplings filled with ground pork and seasonings, wrapped in thin dough skins. They are typically boiled or served in soup, offering a delicate, savory taste with a slippery wrapper and juicy filling.
desc.Shumai: Shumai is an open-topped Chinese dumpling filled with ground pork, often served as dim sum in restaurants. It is steamed and commonly accompanied by soy sauce, providing a tender, juicy texture and savory pork flavor.
desc.Tom kha kai: Tom kha gai is a Thai hot soup made with coconut milk, chicken, galangal, and aromatics. It is simmered to blend the flavors and served hot, tasting creamy, spicy, and sour with a distinctive herbal aroma.
desc.Massaman curry: Massaman curry is a rich, mildly spicy Thai curry made with chicken or other proteins, potatoes, onions, and peanuts in a coconut milk base. It is simmered with a complex paste of spices and aromatics, resulting in a creamy, fragrant, and savory-sweet taste.
desc.Rad naa: Lad na is a Thai-Chinese noodle dish of stir-fried wide rice noodles with meat or seafood, garlic, and Chinese broccoli, topped with a thick, savory gravy. The sauce is made from fermented soybeans and thickened with starch, served hot with a silky texture and umami-rich flavor.
desc.Sikhye: Sikhye is a sweet Korean rice beverage made by fermenting rice with barley malt, resulting in a lightly sweet taste with a subtle tang from fermentation. It is served chilled as a dessert drink containing floating grains of cooked rice, and sometimes pine nuts.
desc.Oyakodon: Oyakodon is a Japanese rice bowl dish where chicken, eggs, and sliced scallions are simmered together in a savory-sweet broth of soy sauce, mirin, and dashi, then served over steamed rice. It has a comforting, umami-rich taste with tender chicken and softly set egg.
desc.Nabemono: Nabe refers to Japanese hot pot dishes where various ingredients like meats, seafood, vegetables, and tofu are simmered together in a flavorful broth at the table. It is served communally, with the broth becoming more savory as ingredients cook, often enjoyed with dipping sauces.
desc.Donburi: Kaisendon is a Japanese rice bowl topped with an assortment of fresh raw seafood such as tuna, salmon, shrimp, and squid, often accompanied by vegetables, roe, and wasabi. It is served with soy sauce or a light dressing, providing bright, oceanic flavors and varied textures over warm rice.
desc.Spring roll: Spring rolls are thin, rolled appetizers filled with a mixture of vegetables, sometimes with ground meat or shrimp, wrapped in a delicate pastry and either deep-fried for crispiness or served fresh. They are commonly accompanied by sweet chili or peanut dipping sauces, delivering a crunchy texture with fresh or savory fillings.
desc.Ulmyeon: Woolmyeon is a Korean-Chinese noodle dish featuring thick wheat noodles in a thickened, chowder-like broth with vegetables, egg, and seafood such as shrimp, squid, and sea cucumber. It is served hot in a mild, savory sauce that coats the ingredients for a comforting, slightly briny taste.
desc.Peking duck: Peking duck features duck roasted until the skin is thin and exceptionally crispy, with the meat sliced and served alongside spring onions, cucumber, and sweet bean sauce wrapped in thin pancakes. It is presented tableside, providing a contrast of crackling skin, tender meat, and fresh, sweet accompaniments.
desc.Laksa: Laksa is a spicy noodle soup made with thick rice noodles, topped with chicken, prawns or fish, and served in a rich coconut curry broth or a sour tamarind-flavored one; it has a bold, creamy, and fiery taste.
desc.Bak kut teh: Bak kut teh is a pork rib soup simmered for hours in a clear herbal broth made with spices like star anise, cinnamon, cloves, and garlic; it tastes savory, aromatic, and slightly medicinal without any actual tea leaves.
desc.Rojak: Rojak is a fruit and vegetable salad tossed in a thick, spicy-sweet dressing made from palm sugar and shrimp paste; it offers a refreshing mix of crunchy textures with hot, tangy, and umami flavors.
desc.Otak-otak: Otak-otak is a fish cake of ground fish blended with spices and coconut milk, wrapped in banana leaves and then steamed or grilled; it has a soft, custardy texture and a fragrant, mildly spicy taste.
desc.Nasi lemak: Nasi lemak is coconut milk rice steamed with pandan leaves, typically served with sambal, fried anchovies, peanuts, cucumber slices, and a boiled or fried egg; the rice is rich and fragrant while the accompaniments add sweet, spicy, and savory contrast.
desc.Teh tarik: Teh tarik is a frothy hot milk tea made by brewing strong black tea with condensed milk and repeatedly pouring it between containers to create aeration; it tastes creamy, sweet, and robust with a silky foam on top.
desc.Durian: Durian is a large tropical fruit with a thick, spiky husk that reveals creamy, custard-like flesh inside; it is eaten fresh and has an intense, complex flavor that is sweet, savory, and slightly fermented with a powerful aroma.
desc.Adobo: Adobo is a Filipino stew of meat such as chicken or pork simmered in a tangy sauce of vinegar, soy sauce, garlic, and black pepper; it is savory, sour, and salty, often served with rice and has tender, flavorful meat.
desc.Sinigang: Sinigang is a sour soup made with meat or fish, vegetables, and tamarind or other souring agents; it has a clear, tangy broth that is savory and refreshing, typically served with rice.
desc.Kaldereta: Kaldereta is a hearty meat stew of beef, goat, or pork cooked with vegetables like potatoes, carrots, and bell peppers in a thick tomato-based sauce spiced with chilies and liver paste; it tastes rich, savory, and mildly spicy.
desc.Tinola: Tinola is a light chicken soup flavored with ginger, onions, and fish sauce, containing green papaya or chayote and chili leaves; it has a clear, aromatic broth that is savory and mildly peppery.
desc.Bicol express: Bicol Express is a spicy pork stew simmered in coconut milk with long green chilies, shrimp paste, garlic, ginger, and onion; it is creamy, fiery hot, and rich with savory pork flavor.
desc.Gulab jamun: Gulab jamun consists of soft, deep-fried milk-solid dumplings soaked in fragrant sugar syrup, often garnished with chopped nuts. It is served warm or at room temperature and tastes sweet, spongy, and mildly aromatic from the syrup.
desc.Kulfi: Kulfi is a dense, creamy frozen dairy dessert similar to ice cream but not churned, made by slowly reducing milk and adding flavors such as mango, pistachio, or cardamom. It is served in molds or on sticks and tastes rich, smooth, and intensely flavored without being overly sweet.
desc.Jalebi: Jalebi is a crisp, deep-fried wheat-flour batter formed into pretzel or spiral shapes, then soaked in sugar syrup until it absorbs the sweetness. It is served hot or warm, often with yogurt, and tastes crunchy outside, juicy inside, and very sweet with a slight fermented tang.
desc.Bhaji: Bajji, also known as bhaji, is a crispy vegetable fritter made by coating slices of onion or other vegetables in a spiced chickpea-flour batter and deep-frying them. It is served hot as a snack or starter and tastes savory, spicy, and crunchy.
desc.Nasi goreng: Nasi goreng is a stir-fried rice dish cooked with pre-cooked rice, sweet soy sauce, shallots, garlic, chili, and shrimp paste, often including egg, chicken, prawns, or vegetables. It is served hot and tastes savory, slightly sweet, smoky, and spicy.
desc.Mie goreng: Mie goreng is an Indonesian stir-fried noodle dish made with thin yellow noodles tossed in oil with garlic, shallots, chili, vegetables, egg, and proteins such as chicken, prawns, or meatballs. It is served hot and tastes savory, slightly sweet, and spicy with a satisfying chew.
desc.Satay: Satay consists of small marinated pieces of meat, seafood, or vegetables threaded on skewers and grilled over charcoal. It is served with a peanut sauce, rice cakes, or pickled vegetables and tastes smoky, tender, and richly flavored with a creamy, nutty sauce.
desc.Rendang: Rendang is a slow-cooked meat dish prepared by simmering beef or other meat in coconut milk with spices until the liquid evaporates, leaving the meat coated in a thick, aromatic glaze. It is served hot with rice and tastes rich, tender, spicy, and deeply savory.
desc.Gado-gado: Gado-gado is an Indonesian vegetable salad combining lightly cooked or raw vegetables, boiled egg, potato, fried tofu, tempeh, and rice cake, all generously dressed with a peanut sauce. It is served at room temperature and tastes fresh, nutty, slightly sweet, and savory.
desc.Ikan bakar: Ikan bakar is charcoal-grilled fish or seafood marinated with spices, sweet soy sauce, and chili, often wrapped in banana leaf during cooking. It is served hot with sambal and tastes smoky, tender, savory, and spicy.
desc.Mango sticky rice: Mango sticky rice is a dessert featuring sweet, chewy glutinous rice soaked in rich coconut milk and topped with fresh ripe mango slices. It is served at room temperature and tastes creamy, tropical, and subtly sweet.
desc.Thai tea: Thai milk tea is a bold black tea brew mixed with sweetened condensed milk and sometimes evaporated milk, served hot or over ice. It tastes creamy, sweet, and aromatic with a smooth, milky finish.
desc.Pho: Pho is a Vietnamese soup made with a clear, aromatic broth poured over rice noodles and thinly sliced beef or chicken, garnished with fresh herbs like cilantro, basil, and bean sprouts. It is served steaming hot and tastes savory, fragrant, and subtly sweet with bright herbal notes.
desc.Bún bò Huế: Bun bo hue is a Vietnamese noodle soup featuring thick rice noodles in a spicy, lemongrass-infused broth with sliced beef, pork knuckles, and Vietnamese ham. It is served hot and garnished with fresh herbs, tasting bold, savory, spicy, and aromatic.
desc.Bún thịt nướng: Bun thit nuong is a Vietnamese dish of cold rice noodles topped with grilled marinated pork, fresh herbs, bean sprouts, pickled vegetables, and spring rolls, then drizzled with sweet-salty fish sauce. It is served at room temperature and tastes smoky, fresh, crunchy, and balanced between sweet, savory, and tangy.
desc.Chả cá Lã Vọng: Cha ca is a Vietnamese grilled fish dish featuring pieces of turmeric-marinated fish cooked tableside in a hot pan with scallions and dill. It is served with rice noodles, fresh herbs, peanuts, and a pungent shrimp sauce, tasting savory, aromatic, and slightly sweet.
desc.Mì Quảng: Mi quang is a Vietnamese noodle dish of wide rice noodles lightly coated in a savory broth or sauce and topped with shrimp, pork, herbs, peanuts, and crispy rice crackers. It is served with a small amount of liquid and tastes earthy, savory, and fresh.
desc.Bánh bao: Banh bao are steamed Vietnamese buns made from a soft, fluffy dough filled with seasoned ground pork, Chinese sausage, hard-boiled egg, mushrooms, and onions. They are served warm and taste savory, slightly sweet, and tender.
desc.Vietnamese iced coffee: Cafe sua da is Vietnamese iced coffee made by brewing strong dark-roast coffee through a metal phin filter directly into sweetened condensed milk, then stirring and pouring over ice. It tastes bold, rich, creamy, and intensely sweet with a smooth, refreshing chill.
desc.Coconut water: Coconut juice, also known as coconut water, is the clear, naturally sweet liquid found inside young green coconuts. It is typically served chilled or over ice as a refreshing beverage, either fresh straight from the coconut or packaged, with a light, subtly nutty flavor.
desc.Butter chicken: Butter chicken is a creamy curry made with tender pieces of chicken simmered in a spiced tomato and butter gravy. It has a rich, mildly spiced flavor and silky texture, usually served with rice or naan bread.
desc.Chicken tikka masala: Chicken tikka masala consists of roasted marinated chicken pieces in a creamy, spiced tomato sauce. It is mildly spicy with aromatic flavors, often served in restaurants with rice or flatbread.
desc.Dal makhani: Dal makhani is a rich, creamy lentil dish made with black lentils and beans slow-cooked in a butter and cream sauce with spices. It has a smooth, velvety texture and mild, earthy flavor, typically served with rice or naan.
desc.Roti: Roti is an unleavened flatbread made from whole-wheat flour and water, cooked on a hot griddle until soft and pliable. It has a simple, earthy flavor and is typically served warm as an accompaniment to curries or other dishes.
desc.Shahi paneer: Paneer butter masala is a creamy curry made with cubes of Indian cottage cheese simmered in a spiced tomato and butter gravy. It has a rich, mildly sweet and aromatic flavor with a silky texture, usually served with rice or naan.
desc.Aloo gobhi: Aloo gobi is a vegetarian dish of potatoes and cauliflower cooked with Indian spices like turmeric, cumin, and coriander. It has a dry or lightly saucy texture with a warm, earthy, and mildly spiced taste, often served as a side with flatbread.
desc.Korma: Chicken korma is a mild curry of chicken braised in a thick sauce made with yogurt, cream, nuts, and aromatic spices. It has a creamy, fragrant, and subtly sweet flavor, typically served with rice or naan in restaurants.
desc.Rogan josh: Rogan josh is an aromatic curry made with tender meat, usually lamb or goat, in a rich gravy flavored with Kashmiri chilies, yogurt, and spices. It has a deep red color, mildly spicy taste, and is often served with rice or bread.
desc.Vindaloo: Vindaloo is a fiery, spicy curry dish made with meat such as pork, chicken, or lamb in a tangy sauce with vinegar, garlic, and hot chilies. It is intensely flavorful and hot, commonly served in restaurants with rice or naan.
desc.Rajma: Rajma is a vegetarian curry of red kidney beans simmered in a thick, spiced tomato gravy with Indian whole spices. It has a hearty, savory flavor and is typically served over rice as a comforting main dish.
desc.Lugaw: Lugaw is a Filipino glutinous rice porridge that can be savory or sweet. It is made by simmering rice in water or broth until soft and creamy, often served warm as a comforting meal with simple toppings like ginger or green onions for a mild, soothing taste.
desc.Pancit: Pancit refers to various traditional Filipino noodle dishes. It is typically made with stir-fried noodles combined with meats, vegetables, and seasonings, served with calamansi for a bright citrusy flavor, resulting in a savory and satisfying taste.
desc.Lumpia: Lumpia are spring rolls made with thin pastry wrappers filled with savory or sweet ingredients. They are often served as appetizers or snacks, either deep-fried until crispy or fresh and unfried, offering a crunchy or delicate texture with flavorful fillings.
desc.Inihaw: Inihaw consists of various grilled or spit-roasted meats like pork or chicken, often served on bamboo skewers. It is cooked over an open flame and accompanied by a soy sauce and vinegar dip, delivering a smoky, savory barbecue flavor.
desc.Halo-halo: Halo-halo is a cold Filipino dessert made with crushed ice, evaporated milk, and a mix of sweetened beans, coconut strips, fruits, jellies, and other preserves. It is layered in a tall glass, often topped with ice cream, and offers a sweet, creamy, and refreshing mix of textures and flavors.
desc.Spaghetti aglio e olio: Spaghetti aglio e olio is a simple Italian pasta dish from Naples made with spaghetti, garlic, olive oil, and often chili flakes. The ingredients are gently cooked and tossed with the pasta, creating a light, aromatic, and mildly spicy flavor with a silky texture.
desc.Risotto: Risotto is an Italian rice dish cooked slowly with broth until it reaches a creamy consistency. It often includes butter, onion, white wine, and Parmesan cheese, served as a first course with a rich, velvety texture and savory taste.
desc.Ossobuco: Osso buco is an Italian dish of cross-cut veal shanks braised with vegetables, white wine, and broth until tender. It is often garnished with a citrus-herb mixture and features a prized marrow in the bone, resulting in a rich, savory, and melt-in-the-mouth flavor.
desc.Flan (British cuisine): Flan is an egg-based open tart with a pastry or sponge base filled with a sweet or savory mixture such as custard or bacon and egg. It is baked until the filling sets and is served in slices either warm or at room temperature, offering a creamy or hearty taste depending on the filling.
desc.Caldo verde: Caldo verde is a Portuguese soup made with finely shredded cabbage or kale, potatoes, olive oil, onions, and garlic. The ingredients are simmered until tender, then the soup is served hot often accompanied by slices of sausage, resulting in a savory, slightly peppery flavor with a silky texture from the potatoes.
desc.Pastel de nata: Pastel de nata is a small Portuguese custard tart made with a crisp, flaky pastry shell filled with a creamy egg custard that is baked until the top develops caramelized spots. It is served warm or at room temperature, sometimes dusted with cinnamon, delivering a contrast of crunchy pastry and smooth, sweet custard.
desc.Francesinha: Francesinha is a Portuguese sandwich from Porto consisting of stacked layers of toasted bread, assorted hot meats like steak, ham, and sausage, topped with melted cheese and a hot tomato-beer sauce. It is served on a plate with fried potato chips, creating a rich, spicy, and saucy taste experience.
desc.Polvo à lagareiro: Polvo à Lagareiro is a Portuguese octopus dish featuring tender boiled or grilled octopus generously drizzled with olive oil, served alongside crushed potatoes, greens, and garlic. The abundant olive oil gives it a rich, savory flavor that highlights the mild, slightly sweet taste of the octopus.
desc.Bacalhau à Brás: Bacalhau à Brás is a Portuguese dish of shredded salt cod combined with thinly sliced fried potatoes, onions, and scrambled eggs. It is gently cooked until the eggs set, then garnished with black olives and parsley, resulting in a savory, flaky texture with salty and mildly garlicky notes.
desc.Profiterole: A profiterole, also known as a cream puff, is a small ball of French choux pastry filled with a sweet and moist mixture such as whipped cream, custard, pastry cream, or ice cream. It is typically garnished with chocolate sauce, caramel, or powdered sugar and served as a dessert.
desc.Mille-feuille: A mille-feuille is a French dessert consisting of layers of crisp puff pastry alternating with pastry cream. It is usually finished on top with icing sugar, cocoa, or pastry crumbs and served as a sweet treat in restaurants and cafés.
desc.Whipped cream: Crème Chantilly, also known as whipped cream, is heavy cream that has been whisked until light and fluffy, often sweetened with sugar and flavored with vanilla. It is commonly served as a topping on desserts or hot beverages and incorporated into other sweet dishes.
desc.Tapas: Tapas are small appetizers or snacks in Spanish cuisine that can be served cold, such as olives and cheese, or hot, such as fried baby squid or spicy potatoes. They are often combined to form a full meal and presented in bars and restaurants.
desc.Spanish omelette: Tortilla Española is a thick omelette made with eggs, potatoes, and often onions. It is cooked in a pan, typically served at room temperature as a tapa or snack in Spanish restaurants.
desc.Jamón: Jamón is a type of dry-cured ham from Spain, thinly sliced and served as part of tapas or as a standalone appetizer in restaurants, with a salty, rich flavor.
desc.Croquette: Croquetas are deep-fried rolls made with a thick béchamel or mashed potato binder mixed with fillings such as chopped meat, seafood, cheese, or vegetables, then breaded and fried until crispy. They are served as snacks or side dishes with a creamy interior and crunchy exterior.
desc.Chili con carne: Chili con carne is a spicy stew made with chili peppers, meat such as beef, tomatoes, and often beans, seasoned with garlic, onions, and cumin. It is simmered until rich and flavorful and commonly served in bowls, sometimes garnished with cheese or salsa.
desc.Gazpacho: Gazpacho is a cold soup made from blended raw vegetables, typically including tomatoes, cucumbers, and peppers. It is served chilled as a refreshing starter or drink in Spanish restaurants, especially in summer.
desc.Picadillo: Picadillo is a minced meat dish made with ground beef, tomatoes, raisins, olives, and varying seasonings. It is cooked together into a savory mixture and served with rice or as a filling in pastries and tacos.
desc.Fabada asturiana: Fabada is a rich, hearty bean stew made with white beans, sausages, pork, and spices. It is slowly cooked until thick and flavorful, then served hot as a starter or main course in Spanish eateries.
desc.Pasta al forno: Pasta al Forno is a baked Italian pasta dish made with short pasta covered in béchamel sauce, tomato sauce, and cheese, then cooked in the oven until bubbly and golden. It has a rich, creamy, and cheesy flavor with a crispy top layer.
desc.Cannelloni: Cannelloni are large cylindrical tubes of egg pasta stuffed with fillings like spinach and ricotta or minced beef, covered in sauce such as tomato, and baked until tender. They offer a hearty, savory taste from the creamy or meaty filling combined with the baked pasta and sauce.
desc.Pasta primavera: Pasta Primavera is an Italian-American dish of pasta served in a light cream sauce tossed with fresh spring vegetables. It is typically made by sautéing or blanching the vegetables before combining them with the cooked pasta and sauce for a fresh, creamy flavor.
desc.Limoncello: Limoncello is a sweet Italian lemon liqueur traditionally served chilled as an after-dinner digestif. It is made by infusing lemon zest in alcohol, then mixing with sugar and water, and has a bright, tangy citrus taste with a smooth, slightly syrupy texture.
desc.Quiche Lorraine: Quiche Lorraine is a savory French tart with a flaky pastry crust filled with a creamy custard of eggs, cream, and bacon. It is baked until set and golden, offering a rich, silky texture with smoky, salty flavors from the bacon.
desc.Ratatouille: Ratatouille is a French vegetable stew made by cooking seasonal summer produce such as tomatoes, zucchini, eggplant, peppers, and onions in olive oil. The vegetables are simmered until soft, creating a flavorful, chunky dish with a fresh, herby taste.
desc.Bouillabaisse: Bouillabaisse is a Provençal fish soup made with a variety of bony fish and shellfish simmered in a broth flavored with tomatoes, garlic, herbs, and saffron. It is served hot, often with toasted bread and rouille, and has a robust, aromatic seafood flavor.
desc.Beef bourguignon: Beef Bourguignon is a French stew made by braising beef in red wine with beef stock, carrots, onions, garlic, and a bouquet garni, then garnished with pearl onions and mushrooms. It results in fork-tender meat in a thick, flavorful wine-based sauce.
desc.Cassoulet: Cassoulet is a rich French stew combining white beans with meats such as sausage, pork, and duck confit, slowly cooked until the beans are creamy and the meats are tender. It is served hot with a golden, crusty top and deep, savory flavors.
desc.Crêpe: Crêpes are thin French pancakes made from a simple batter of flour, eggs, and milk, cooked on a hot griddle until delicate and lacy. They can be served sweet with fillings like fruit or spreads, or savory with cheese, vegetables, or meats, and have a light, tender texture.
desc.Tarte Tatin: Tarte Tatin is a French upside-down tart in which fruit, usually apples, is caramelized in butter and sugar before being topped with pastry and baked. It is inverted after baking to reveal glossy, caramelized fruit on a crisp base, offering a sweet, buttery, and tender flavor.
desc.Melomakarono: Melomakarona is an egg-shaped Greek dessert made primarily from flour, olive oil, and honey, often filled with ground walnuts before being baked and then immersed in a cold honey syrup. It has a sweet, moist texture with flavors of cinnamon, clove, and orange.
desc.Ouzo: Ouzo is a dry anise-flavored Greek aperitif made from rectified spirits that are distilled and flavored. It has a strong licorice-like taste similar to other anise-based spirits and is typically served as an aperitif.
desc.Frappé coffee: Frappé is a Greek iced coffee drink made from instant coffee, water, sugar, ice, and often milk, shaken or blended to create a frothy texture. It is refreshing, mildly sweet, and commonly enjoyed cold.
desc.Doner kebab: Döner kebab is a Turkish dish of seasoned meat cooked on a vertical rotisserie, sliced into thin shavings and typically served in a sandwich or wrap with accompaniments. It features tender, flavorful meat with a mix of spices and is often accompanied by vegetables and sauces.
desc.Lahmacun: Lahmacun is a Middle Eastern flatbread topped with minced meat, vegetables, herbs, and spices like chili and paprika, then baked until crispy. It is often served wrapped around fresh or pickled vegetables and has a savory, spiced flavor.
desc.Meze: Meze is a selection of small dishes served as appetizers in Eastern Mediterranean cuisines, often including dips, salads, and bites paired with drinks. They are varied in flavor, from fresh and tangy to rich and savory, and can form a full meal.
desc.Börek: Börek is a family of flaky pastries made from thin dough like filo, filled with ingredients such as meat, cheese, spinach, or potatoes, and baked or fried. They have a crisp texture and can be served hot or cold, often with yogurt.
desc.Ginjinha: Ginjinha is a Portuguese cherry liqueur made by infusing sour cherries in aguardente with sugar, cloves, and cinnamon. It is served as a shot, often with a cherry at the bottom of the cup, and has a sweet, fruity, and spiced taste.
desc.Souvlaki: Souvlaki consists of small pieces of usually pork meat grilled on a skewer. It is served hot, either straight from the skewer or in a pita with lemon, sauces, tomato, onion, and fries, offering a juicy, savory, and lightly charred flavor.
desc.Tiropita: Tiropita is a Greek cheese pie made with layers of buttered phyllo pastry filled with a mixture of cheese and eggs. It is baked until golden and flaky, then served warm or at room temperature with a savory, cheesy taste.
desc.Taramasalata: Taramasalata is a Greek meze dip made from cured fish roe mixed with olive oil, lemon juice, and a base of bread or potatoes. It is served as a spread on bread and has a creamy, salty, and slightly tangy flavor that can range from beige to pink in color.
desc.Lokma: Loukoumades are Greek deep-fried dough balls that are soaked in syrup or honey and sometimes dusted with cinnamon. They are served warm and taste sweet, crispy on the outside, and soft inside with a honeyed flavor.
desc.Rice pudding: Rizogalo is a Greek rice pudding made by cooking rice in milk with sugar and often flavored with vanilla or cinnamon. It is served chilled or at room temperature and has a creamy, mildly sweet taste with a soft, comforting texture.
desc.Turkish delight: Turkish delight or lokum is a confection made from a starch and sugar gel, often containing chopped nuts such as pistachios or walnuts and flavored with rosewater, lemon, or mastic. It is cut into small soft, chewy cubes that are dusted with powdered sugar to prevent sticking.
desc.Turkish coffee: Turkish coffee is a strong, unfiltered brew prepared by simmering very finely ground coffee beans in a special pot called a cezve, resulting in a thick, dark liquid with a layer of foam on top. It is served hot in small cups, often with grounds settled at the bottom, delivering an intense, aromatic flavor.
desc.Rakı: Rakı is an anise-flavored Turkish alcoholic drink made by twice-distilling grape pomace and infusing it with aniseed, reaching at least 40% alcohol content. It is typically served as an apéritif, often diluted with water which turns it milky white, and pairs well with seafood or meze for a refreshing, licorice-like taste.
desc.Baba ghanoush: Baba ganoush is a Levantine appetizer of roasted eggplant that is peeled and mashed with tahini, olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, and seasonings. The eggplant is traditionally cooked over an open flame for a smoky flavor, creating a soft, creamy dip served with pita bread.
desc.Shakshouka: Shakshuka is a dish of eggs poached in a sauce made from tomatoes, olive oil, peppers, onion, and garlic, spiced with cumin, paprika, and cayenne. The eggs are gently cooked in the bubbling sauce and served directly from the pan for a savory, spicy, and hearty meal.
desc.Muhallebi: Muhallebi is a creamy milk pudding made with rice, sugar, and milk, thickened using rice flour, starch, or semolina. It is gently cooked until smooth and thick, then served chilled as a light, delicately flavored dessert.
desc.Jallab: Jallab is a sweet, refreshing fruit syrup drink made from carob, dates, grape molasses, and rose water, sometimes with grenadine. It is typically served cold over crushed ice, garnished with pine nuts and raisins, offering a fragrant, fruity flavor.
desc.Chimichanga: A chimichanga is a deep-fried burrito filled with rice, beans, cheese, and meats such as shredded chicken or beef. It is served crispy and hot, often topped with salsa, guacamole, or sour cream for a crunchy, savory taste.
desc.Al pastor: Tacos al pastor feature thinly sliced, spit-grilled marinated pork served in soft corn tortillas. The meat is flavored with a tangy adobada marinade, resulting in tender, juicy slices with a smoky, savory taste, usually accompanied by onion, cilantro, and pineapple.
desc.Carne asada: Carne asada is thinly sliced, grilled beef, typically skirt, flank, or flap steak that has been marinated and seared for a charred flavor. It is served hot, either on its own or as a filling, with a smoky, tender, and juicy taste.
desc.Carnitas: Carnitas are tender, juicy pieces of pork that are braised, simmered, and then fried in their own fat or lard until crispy on the outside. They are typically served hot with cilantro, onion, salsa, and tortillas, offering a rich, savory flavor.
desc.Pozole: Pozole is a hearty Mexican soup or stew made with hominy and meat such as chicken or pork, seasoned with chili peppers, garlic, and onion. It is served hot and garnished with shredded cabbage, radishes, avocado, or lime, delivering a comforting, savory, and mildly spicy taste.
desc.Tres leches cake: Tres leches cake is a light, airy sponge cake soaked in a mixture of evaporated, condensed, and whole milk until moist. It is often topped with whipped cream and fruit or cinnamon, resulting in a sweet, creamy, and tender texture and taste.
desc.Horchata: Horchata is a sweet, milky beverage made from rice, cinnamon, and sugar, sometimes with added milk or vanilla. It is served cold as a refreshing drink, with a smooth, subtly spiced, and lightly sweet flavor.
desc.Tamarind juice: Tamarind juice is a beverage made by extracting the sweet-sour pulp of tamarind into water. It is appreciated as a refreshing drink for its fresh sour taste and can also be used as a tart flavoring in cocktails and mixed drinks.
desc.Corona (beer): Corona is a pale lager beer often served with a wedge of lime or lemon inserted in the neck of the bottle to add tartness and flavor. It is brewed from barley malt, hops, and corn, resulting in a light and crisp taste.
desc.Grilled cheese: A grilled cheese sandwich is a hot sandwich made by placing cheese between slices of bread and cooking it in butter or mayonnaise on a pan or griddle until the bread browns and the cheese melts. It has a crispy exterior with gooey, melted cheese inside.
desc.Cobb salad: Cobb salad is a main-course garden salad composed of chopped greens, tomato, bacon, chicken, hard-boiled eggs, avocado, chives, and blue cheese, arranged in neat rows. It is typically dressed with red wine vinaigrette for a fresh and savory taste.
desc.Buffalo wing: Buffalo wings, often called chicken wings, are unbreaded chicken wing sections that are deep-fried and coated in a sauce of cayenne pepper hot sauce and melted butter. They are served hot with celery, carrots, and a dip like ranch or blue cheese dressing, delivering a spicy and tangy flavor.
desc.Chicken-fried steak: Chicken-fried steak is a breaded beefsteak cutlet coated in seasoned flour and deep-fried or pan-fried until crispy. It is served as a savory main dish with a crunchy exterior and tender meat inside, resembling fried chicken in preparation.
desc.Macaroni and cheese: Mac and cheese is a pasta dish of macaroni covered in a creamy cheddar cheese sauce, often prepared as a baked casserole or on the stovetop. It is a comforting, rich, and cheesy meal with a smooth and satisfying texture.
desc.Apple pie: Apple pie is a fruit pie with a filling of apples enclosed in shortcrust pastry that may be solid or latticed on top. It is baked until the crust is golden and the apples are tender, offering a sweet and spiced flavor.
desc.Lūʻau: Laulau is a Polynesian dish made by wrapping taro leaves around fillings and steaming them until tender. It has a soft, dense texture that can range from soup-like to cake-like, with a mild, earthy taste often enhanced by coconut milk.
desc.Haupia: Haupia is a traditional Hawaiian coconut pudding made from coconut milk thickened into a firm, creamy dessert. It has a smooth, mildly sweet coconut taste and is often served chilled in squares.
desc.Malassada: Malasada is a Portuguese fried doughnut made from yeasted dough that is flattened, deep-fried until golden, and coated in sugar and cinnamon. It has a soft, pillowy texture with a sweet and slightly spiced flavor.
desc.Mai Tai: The Mai Tai is a cocktail made with rum, Curaçao liqueur, orgeat syrup, and lime juice. It is shaken and served over ice, delivering a balanced sweet, sour, and nutty tropical taste.
desc.Helles: Helles is a pale German lager beer with a bright, light golden color. It is brewed using bottom fermentation with a focus on malt flavors, resulting in a crisp, refreshing taste that is mildly sweet and low in bitterness.
desc.Kölsch (beer): Kölsch is a pale, clear German beer with a bright gold hue, brewed as a top-fermenting ale that is then cold-conditioned. It is highly attenuated and hoppy, offering a crisp, refreshing taste with subtle fruitiness and a clean finish.
desc.Apfelwein: Apfelwein is a German-style cider made from tart, sour apples through fermentation. It is typically dry with an alcohol content around 5-7%, resulting in a crisp, tart, and refreshing taste that is quite sour.
desc.Mulled wine: Glühwein is a hot mulled wine made with red wine, spices, and sometimes raisins. It is warmed and served steaming, offering a spiced, fruity flavor that is sweet and aromatic with hints of cinnamon and cloves.
desc.Black Forest gateau: Black Forest cake is a layered German dessert made from chocolate sponge cake, whipped cream, cherries, and Kirsch liqueur. It is assembled with cream and cherry fillings between layers and decorated with chocolate shavings and cherries, tasting rich, creamy, and lightly cherry-flavored.
desc.Apple strudel: Apple strudel is a flaky pastry made from thin stretched dough filled with spiced apples, raisins, and breadcrumbs. It is rolled, baked until golden and crisp, and often served warm with powdered sugar or vanilla sauce, offering a sweet-tart apple taste with buttery pastry.
